items.title: 花旗：2027年北上深等核心城市二手房價格或迎拐點
items.title_en: Citi: 2027 May Mark Turning Point for Resale Home Prices in Core Cities Like Beijing, Shanghai, and Shenzhen
paras: 花旗集團近日發布名為《2027年中國房地產市場展望》的研究報告指出，在經歷數年整體調整後，中國房地產市場正出現結構性轉變，預測2027年北京、上海、深圳等核心城市的二手房價格將迎來實質拐點。
然而，花旗強調，這並不代表全國房價將再度出現全面性普漲，而是象徵整體市場由過往的「新建案主導」轉向「存量二手房為主」，並開啟區域深度分化的全新階段。
花旗報告分析，過去二十餘年由建商購地、開發與預售新建案來引導價格的模式已逐漸改變。數據顯示，截至2026年，二手房交易面積已佔中國全國商品住宅交易的半數；預計到2027年，二手房交易額佔比將進一步提升至全市場的58%，總規模估計達7.7兆元人民幣，呈現逆勢年增3%的態勢。
報告引述研調觀點表示，買方轉向二手房市場的主要考量在於價格由市場供需機制決定、議價空間透明，且無預售屋延期或斷尾的交屋風險，加上社區品質、周邊配套與房屋狀況均為實體呈現。
市場統計顯示，截至2026年9月，上海二手房價格同比已轉為正成長(年增0.8%)，北京與深圳的同比跌幅亦持續收斂，顯示一線城市的二手房市場已率先出現止跌走穩的訊號。
花旗研調團隊指出，核心城市房價之所以預期在2027年出現價格拐點，主要歸因於以下五項正在發生的供需變化：
高轉手率消化歷史賣壓：過去幾年的高成交量已有效消化過往的投機籌碼。例如北京2021至2024年的二手房成交量，已相當於2017至2024年間投資性購房總量的220%；杭州、上海與深圳的比例亦分別達151%、134%及123%。投資盤逐步轉換為自住買方，使持倉成本與市場現價接軌，降低了後續行情回暖時解套盤拋售的壓力。
委售掛牌量見頂回落：截至2026年10月，全國39個重點城市二手房委售掛牌量較2025年底下降3%，一線城市較2025年3月高點回落16%，其中上海下降19%、北京降幅逾15%。一線城市的去化週期已縮短至9個月，賣方降價意願減少，支撐價格止跌。
租金行情止跌回升：2026年以來一線城市住宅租金率先反彈，前8個月上海租金累計上漲4.5%、深圳上漲1.1%，反映實質居住需求回流，亦提升房屋的持有價值。
居民儲蓄餘額創新高：截至2026年9月，居民儲蓄餘額達175兆元人民幣(年增7%)，顯示民間潛在購買力充沛，主要受制於對房價走勢的觀望態度。
人口持續流入核心城：2022至2025年間，全國26個重點城市常住人口合計增加420萬人，其中深圳、廣州、杭州等城人口成長顯著，為住宅市場提供穩固的基本盤。
與二手房市場走穩相對應的是，新建案市場正面臨供給側的大幅收縮。花旗報告估算，2027年全國住宅新開工面積與竣工面積將分別年減20.5%與22%，回落至約2.5億平方公尺(相當於2000至2002年水準)；土地成交面積預計再降33%。
在政策層面，花旗報告指出，政策邏輯已從過往的「全面刺激」轉變為「托底防線」。隨著房地產業對GDP直接與間接貢獻率預計在2027年降至8%、土地出讓金佔地方財政比重降至16%，系統性風險已大幅釋放，政府政策重點轉為調降房屋貸款利息補貼等精準托底措施。同時，推動「現房銷售」(成屋銷售)等新發展模式，終結高槓桿、高周轉的舊有營運型態。
paras_en: Citi Group recently released a research report titled "2027 China Real Estate Market Outlook" stating that after several years of overall adjustment, China’s real estate market is undergoing a structural shift, and it forecasts that resale home prices in core cities such as Beijing, Shanghai and Shenzhen will reach a substantive turning point by 2027.

However, Citi stresses that this does not mean a nationwide resurgence in house prices, but rather signals a transition of the overall market from being "new‑construction‑driven" to being "stock‑of‑existing‑homes‑driven," ushering in a new phase of deep regional differentiation.

The Citi report analyses that the past two decades’ model of developers buying land, building and pre‑selling new projects to guide prices has gradually changed. Data show that by the end of 2026, resale home transaction area already accounted for half of all commodity residential transactions in China; it is expected that by 2027 the share of resale transaction value will rise to 58% of the whole market, with a total scale estimated at RMB 7.7 trillion, showing a contrarian annual growth of 3%.

The report quotes research views that buyers are shifting to the resale market mainly because prices are set by market supply‑and‑demand, bargaining space is transparent, and there is no risk of delayed delivery or unfinished projects that plague pre‑sales, while community quality, surrounding amenities and the condition of the house are all physically observable.

Market statistics show that as of September 2026, Shanghai’s resale home prices have turned positive year‑on‑year (+0.8%), and the year‑on‑year declines in Beijing and Shenzhen have continued to narrow, indicating that first‑tier cities’ resale markets have already shown early signs of stopping the decline and stabilising.
Citi’s research team points out that the expected price turning point in core cities in 2027 is mainly due to five supply‑and‑demand changes currently underway:

High turnover rates have absorbed historic selling pressure: the high transaction volumes of recent years have effectively soaked up previous speculative chips. For example, Beijing’s resale transaction volume from 2021 to 2024 equals 220% of the total investment‑home purchases from 2017 to 2024; the ratios for Hangzhou, Shanghai and Shenzhen are 151%, 134% and 123% respectively. The investment side is gradually converting to owner‑occupiers, aligning holding costs with current market prices and reducing pressure from forced sales when the market rebounds.

Listing volume of entrusted sales has peaked and is now falling: by October 2026, the entrusted resale listing volume in 39 key cities nationwide fell 3% from the end of 2025, and in first‑tier cities it dropped 16% from the March 2025 peak, with Shanghai down 19% and Beijing over 15%. The clearance cycle in first‑tier cities has shortened to nine months, sellers’ willingness to cut prices has lessened, supporting price stabilization.

Rental rates have stopped falling and are rebounding: since 2026, residential rents in first‑tier cities have led the recovery, with Shanghai’s rent up 4.5% and Shenzhen’s up 1.1% over the first eight months, reflecting a return of genuine housing demand and also raising the holding value of homes.

Household savings balances hit a record high: as of September 2026, household savings reached RMB 175 trillion, up 7% year‑on‑year, indicating abundant latent purchasing power, though it remains constrained by cautious sentiment toward price trends.

Population continues to flow into core cities: between 2022 and 2025, the resident population of 26 key cities nationwide grew by 4.2 million, with especially notable growth in Shenzhen, Guangzhou, Hangzhou and other cities, providing a solid base for the housing market.

Corresponding to the stabilisation of the resale market, the new‑construction market is facing a sharp supply‑side contraction. Citi estimates that in 2027 the national residential new‑construction start area and completion area will each decline annually by 20.5% and 22% respectively, falling to about 250 million square metres (roughly the 2000‑2002 level); land transaction area is expected to drop another 33%.

On the policy front, Citi notes that the policy logic has shifted from past "broad stimulus" to a "bottom‑line safeguard." With the real‑estate sector’s direct and indirect contribution to GDP projected to fall to 8% by 2027 and land‑sale revenues’ share of local finances dropping to 16%, systemic risk has been largely released, and government focus has moved to precise support measures such as lowering mortgage interest subsidies. At the same time, new development models like "sale of existing homes" are being promoted to end the old high‑leverage, high‑turnover operating mode.

items.title: 國泰世華銀看Fed「鷹派暫停」、保留後續緊縮空間 股市震盪恐加劇
items.title_en: Cathay United Bank Sees Fed "Hawkish Pause" and Keeps Room for Further Tightening; Stock Market Volatility May Worsen
paras: 美國聯準會(Fed)公布最新利率決策，聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)以 10 比 2 的票數決議將政策利率維持在 3.75% 至 4.00% 區間，符合市場預期。國泰世華銀行針對 FOMC 會後聲明分析，本次按兵不動屬於「鷹派暫停」，雖然短期利率政策維持穩定，但在通膨高檔及地緣政治風險下，Fed 仍保留了後續的緊縮空間。預期短線股市震盪加劇，將回歸獲利與財務基本面。

國泰世華銀行指出，本次會議表決中，官員 Lisa Cook 與 Beth Hammack 主張應升息一碼，顯示內部對通膨仍存戒心。Fed 主席華許(Kevin Warsh)會後表示，美國經濟在強勁消費與企業投資帶動下持續擴張，失業率低於一年前；然而，通膨已連續六年高於 2% 目標，現階段仍處於「資訊豐富期」，需要更多時間與數據來評估未來的貨幣政策走向。此外，Fed 也宣布調整未來的利率決策會議次數，2027 年將調整為 7 次，2028 年則降至 6 次。
針對 10 月暫停升息的主因，國泰世華銀行分析有兩大關鍵，首先，本輪通膨主要由能源供給壓力引發，Fed 意在避免過度緊縮對實體經濟造成衝擊。其次，先前美債殖利率飆升至近年高點，市場早已反應升息預期，進而帶動整體金融與信用環境緊縮，減少了 Fed 進一步大幅升息的迫切性。
不過，國泰世華銀行提醒，考量美伊衝突仍具高度不確定性，且通膨改善幅度有限，今年 12 月與明年 3 月仍有相當大的升息可能性，後續路徑將視地緣政治變化及原油運輸恢復狀況而定。
至於股市方面，國泰世華銀行認為，在高利率與高評價面雙重壓力下，市場短期波動恐將放大。近期市場開始審視科技與 AI 投資的回收進度及融資成本壓力，科技股短期內不排除持續震盪。
不過，壓力將主要集中於高槓桿企業，大型科技龍頭與雲端服務供應商(CSP)憑藉穩健的現金流與獲利能力，仍有能力支撐 AI 投資。中長期而言，AI 發展大趨勢不變，市場焦點將從「評價面擴張」轉向「獲利成長與財務品質」。
債市與匯市部分，近期科技股修正誘發避險資金流入債市，帶動美債殖利率自高點回落。然而，受 Fed 高利率政策、美國財政赤字加劇、公債供給增加及企業融資需求等因素影響，長端利率中樞預計仍將維持在高檔。匯市方面，在聯準會維持鷹派政策的支撐下，美元短期內仍將維持相對偏強的走勢。
paras_en: The U.S. Federal Reserve announced its latest rate decision, with the Federal Open Market Committee voting 10‑2 to keep the policy rate in the 3.75%‑4.00% range, in line with market expectations. Cathay United Bank’s post‑FOMC statement analysis characterises this hold as a “hawkish pause.” While short‑term rate policy remains stable, the Fed retains room for further tightening amid high inflation and geopolitical risks. The bank expects short‑term market volatility to intensify, with a return to focus on earnings and financial fundamentals.

Cathay United Bank noted that in the vote, officials Lisa Cook and Beth Hammack advocated for a one‑point rate hike, indicating lingering internal concerns about inflation. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh said after the meeting that the U.S. economy continues to expand on the back of strong consumer spending and corporate investment, with unemployment lower than a year ago; however, inflation has stayed above the 2% target for six consecutive years and the economy is still in an “information‑rich period,” requiring more time and data to assess future monetary policy. The Fed also announced it will adjust the number of policy meetings, moving to seven meetings in 2027 and six in 2028.

Regarding the main reasons for the October pause, Cathay United Bank identified two key factors. First, the current inflation surge is driven mainly by energy‑supply pressures, and the Fed aims to avoid an overly aggressive tightening that could hurt the real economy. Second, U.S. Treasury yields had already spiked to near‑recent highs, prompting the market to price in rate hikes and tightening overall financial and credit conditions, reducing the urgency for the Fed to raise rates further.

Nevertheless, Cathay United Bank warned that the ongoing U.S.–Iran conflict remains highly uncertain and inflation improvements are modest, leaving a sizable chance of another rate hike in December this year or March next year. The subsequent path will depend on geopolitical developments and the restoration of oil‑transport flows.

On equities, the bank believes that the dual pressure of high rates and lofty valuations could amplify short‑term market swings. Recently, investors have begun scrutinising the rollout of technology and AI investments and the pressure from financing costs, so tech stocks could continue to oscillate in the near term.

However, the pressure will mainly affect highly leveraged firms. Large‑cap tech leaders and cloud‑service providers (CSPs) enjoy solid cash flows and earnings power, enabling them to sustain AI spending. Over the medium to long term, the AI growth trend remains unchanged, and market focus will shift from “valuation expansion” to “profit growth and financial quality.”

In the bond and currency markets, the recent tech‑stock pullback has prompted a flight to safety into bonds, pulling U.S. Treasury yields down from their peaks. Yet, due to the Fed’s high‑rate stance, widening U.S. fiscal deficits, increased sovereign‑debt supply and corporate financing needs, long‑term rates are expected to stay elevated. In the FX market, with the Fed maintaining a hawkish policy, the dollar is likely to remain relatively strong in the short term.

paras: 聯準會 (Fed) 10月決策會議宣布維持政策利率不變，符合市場預期，但決策官員對後續升息時機出現分歧。聯準會主席華許強調，暫停升息不代表抗通膨立場轉變，後續政策仍保有高度彈性。富達國際對此分析，在美國經濟展現成長韌性且人工智慧相關資本支出支撐下，通膨降溫過程恐較為緩慢。富達預估聯準會12月及明年3月仍各有一次升息空間，且聯準會將調整會議制度以增加政策策略討論。建議投資人維持均衡配置，保留因應市場變化的彈性。
美國聯準會10月決議將政策利率維持在3.75至4.00區間，此舉符合市場原先預期，整體決策核心仍以觀察通膨趨勢為主。不過會後聲明不僅上修對經濟活動的評估，更有兩位官員表態支持再升息一碼，反映出決策核心層次對於當前經濟環境與進一步升息的時機，看法已經產生分歧。市場目光隨之轉向年底以及明年的貨幣政策路徑。
針對外界關注的通膨走向，聯準會主席華許明確表示，儘管9月通膨數據尚未達成政策目標，但當局不會僅憑單一數據就採取行動，而是持續觀察整體的通膨發展趨勢。華許強調，當前雖然金融環境已經趨緊，但還難以認定達到足夠的緊縮水準，意味暫停升息絕非抗通膨立場轉變。由於本次會議並未提供明確的利率前瞻指引，未來的升息決策依然取決於通膨降溫的進展以及美國總體經濟動能。
聯準會也在本次會議預告未來的制度變革。華許宣布自2027年秋季開始，將會安排一次專屬會議討論長期的貨幣政策策略，且不進行利率決策。到了2028年預計將正式採行6加2會議新制，也就是將每年8次會議當中的2次改為政策策略討論，讓官員能有充足時間研議中長期的貨幣發展方向。
針對聯準會的最新動態，富達國際資深全球宏觀策略師Max Stainton指出，美國經濟目前持續展現強勁韌性，人工智慧相關資本支出更是支撐經濟與獲利的重要動能。加上勞動市場近期再度轉強，可能導致通膨壓力維持較長時間。富達預期美國通膨率將在2026年底達到約3.4，並於明年逐步回落至2.5。在全球供給限制等變數影響下，聯準會勢必需要延續升息周期，才能確保通膨朝向目標靠攏。
展望利率政策路徑，富達預期聯準會將於今年12月及明年3月各別升息一碼，若供給鏈限制揮之不去，不排除額外再升息一次。展望2027年，高利率對於房市、消費及其他利率敏感產業的影響將逐步顯現，預期美國經濟成長將溫和放緩，逐步朝向長期趨勢水準靠攏，但不至於出現明顯衰退。
儘管企業獲利與人工智慧投資持續為市場提供支撐，全球公債殖利率維持高檔伴隨財政壓力與地緣政治不確定性，讓投資環境更具挑戰。在當前市場漲勢集中，且不同資產對利率變化的敏感度存在差異下，未來機會可能進一步分化。富達目前對股票、信用債、公債及現金均維持中性立場，建議短期操作著重觀察市場風險與評價面變化，伺機掌握重新訂價的配置機會。
paras_en: The Federal Reserve’s October policy meeting kept the target rate unchanged, matching market expectations, but officials were divided on the timing of future hikes. Chair Jerome Powell stressed that pausing rate hikes does not signal a shift in the anti‑inflation stance and that policy remains highly flexible. Fidelity International analyses that, given the resilience of the U.S. economy and AI‑related capital spending, the disinflation process may be slower. Fidelity forecasts a possible rate hike in December and another in March 2025, and notes the Fed will adjust its meeting format to allow more policy‑strategy discussion. Investors are advised to maintain balanced allocations and keep flexibility to respond to market changes.

The Fed’s October decision left the policy rate in the 3.75‑4.00% range, as markets had anticipated, with the core focus still on monitoring inflation trends. However, the post‑meeting statement not only upgraded the assessment of economic activity but also featured two officials who voiced support for another one‑basis‑point hike, highlighting a split among policymakers on the current environment and the timing of further tightening. Market attention therefore shifted to the year‑end and next‑year monetary‑policy path.

Addressing inflation concerns, Chair Powell said that although September’s inflation data had not yet met the policy target, the Fed would not act on a single data point but would continue to watch the overall inflation trajectory. He emphasized that while financial conditions have tightened, they are not yet sufficiently restrictive, meaning the pause does not constitute a change in the anti‑inflation stance. Because the meeting did not provide explicit forward guidance, future hikes will depend on the progress of disinflation and the broader U.S. economic momentum.

The Fed also previewed institutional changes at the meeting. Powell announced that starting in the fall of 2027, a dedicated meeting will be held to discuss long‑term monetary‑policy strategy without making rate decisions. In 2028, the Fed plans to adopt a “6‑plus‑2” format, converting two of the eight annual meetings into policy‑strategy sessions to give officials ample time to consider medium‑ and long‑term monetary directions.

Commenting on the Fed’s latest moves, Fidelity senior global macro strategist Max Stainton said the U.S. economy continues to show strong resilience, with AI‑related capital spending serving as a key driver of growth and earnings. A recently strengthening labor market could keep inflation pressures elevated for an extended period. Fidelity expects U.S. inflation to reach about 3.4% by the end of 2026 and then gradually fall to 2.5% next year. Given global supply‑chain constraints, the Fed will likely need to continue the tightening cycle to steer inflation toward its target.

Looking ahead at the rate path, Fidelity projects the Fed will raise rates by one basis point each in December 2024 and March 2025, and may consider an additional hike if supply‑chain bottlenecks persist. By 2027, the impact of higher rates on housing, consumption and other rate‑sensitive sectors should become clearer, with U.S. growth expected to moderate gently toward its long‑run trend without triggering a sharp recession.

Although corporate earnings and AI investment continue to support markets, global sovereign‑bond yields remain elevated amid fiscal pressures and geopolitical uncertainty, making the investment environment more challenging. With the current market rally concentrated and assets reacting differently to rate changes, opportunities may further diverge. Fidelity maintains a neutral stance on equities, credit, sovereign bonds and cash, advising short‑term traders to monitor market risk and valuation shifts and to be ready to capture re‑pricing opportunities.

paras_en: A recent Goldman Sachs report shows that, based on the long‑term historical trend of the S&P 500, the index’s EPS is projected to be $261 in 2026, but the actual estimate could reach $326. In 1995, U.S. companies’ net profit margin was only about 6%; by 2026 it is expected to climb to 13%, driven largely by the explosive growth of the AI industry.

The S&P 500 and Nasdaq each hit all‑time highs in early October, reflecting the profit growth of U.S. firms. The S&P 500 has risen about 13% year‑to‑date as of yesterday (Oct 28), while its price‑to‑earnings (P/E) ratio and forward P/E have fallen from 28× and 21.3× at the end of last year to 25.9× and 19× respectively.

According to market data, AI‑related companies make up roughly 50% of the S&P 500 constituents and over 70% of the Nasdaq constituents. The Nasdaq has gained about 14% YTD as of Oct 28, with its P/E and forward P/E dropping from roughly 35× and 25.4× at year‑end to about 28× and 20×. The Nasdaq’s gain is slightly higher than the S&P 500’s, but its valuation decline is larger because the fast‑growing AI sector carries a heavier weight in the Nasdaq.

Two major reasons prevent the S&P 500 and Nasdaq returns from fully reflecting fundamentals: growth limits and mean‑reversion.

Take Nvidia (NVDA‑US) as an example: its FY2027 Q2 gross margin is projected at about 75%, and FY2028 gross margin is expected at 72‑73%, indicating a margin peak. This helps explain why Nvidia’s market cap has topped $5.1 trillion while its forward P/E is only 18×, which does not fully capture the fundamentals.

The underlying concern is that a slowdown in AI cloud spending could not only hit U.S. corporate earnings’ growth ceiling but also expose them to mean‑reversion risk.

paras: 砷化鎵PA大廠穩懋(3105-TW)昨(28)日自結第3季財報，因單季繳出EPS 4.55元亮眼佳績，加上法人上調目標價，今(29)日在大盤大舉拉回崩跌近千點下，股價仍逆勢開高走高，亮燈攻上漲停板，股價觸及漲停價594元，逼近600大關，成交量也爆量增至5.5萬張，站上所有均線。
穩懋第3季受惠高階手機拉貨強勁、光通訊及基礎建設雙重挹注下，營運明顯回溫，單季合併營收達58.59億元、年增30.55%，創2022年以來單季新高，單季稅後純益19.3億元、季增98%，隨著產品組合持續優化，也上修本業毛利率預估值。
穩懋在法說上表示，現階段衛星、航太等基礎設施及光通訊相關營收佔比已過半，看好第4季在季營收、毛利率上有望持續走揚。
此外，穩懋光通訊新業務也持續推進中，EML及CW Laser等技術持續與客戶合作推進相關專案中，預期明(2027)年將小量產出。
法人報告指出，穩懋後市將受惠於AI光通訊、基礎建設需求強勁，加上低軌衛星及光通訊雙動能，預期明(2027)年獲利有望維持強勁成長，除了維持「買進」投資建議，也提高穩懋目標超過700元以上。
paras_en: Wenmao (3105-TW), a major GaAs PA manufacturer, released its Q3 financial results yesterday (28th). With an impressive quarterly EPS of NT$4.55 and an upward target price adjustment by institutions, the stock opened higher and surged despite the market’s near‑NT$1,000 point plunge, hitting the daily limit‑up at NT$594, close to the NT$600 mark, with volume exploding to 55,000 lots and moving above all moving averages.

In Q3, Wenmao benefited from strong pull‑in orders for high‑end smartphones and dual support from optical communications and infrastructure projects, leading to a clear operational rebound. Consolidated revenue reached NT$5.859 billion, up 30.55% year‑on‑year, a quarterly high since 2022, while net profit after tax was NT$1.93 billion, up 98% quarter‑on‑quarter. Ongoing product mix optimization also prompted an upward revision of the core gross‑margin outlook.

During its earnings briefing, Wenmao noted that revenue from satellite, aerospace infrastructure and optical communications now accounts for more than half of its business, and it is optimistic that Q4 revenue and gross margin will continue to improve.

In addition, Wenmao’s new optical‑communication ventures are progressing, with technologies such as EML and CW lasers being developed in collaboration with customers, and small‑scale production is expected to begin in 2027.

Research reports indicate that Wenmao will benefit from strong AI optical‑communication and infrastructure demand, as well as dual engines from low‑earth‑orbit satellites and optical communications. Profitability is expected to remain robust into 2027. The recommendation remains a “Buy,” with the target price raised to above NT$700.

paras: 今天大盤又向下震盪，一度重挫，但穩懋 (3105-TW)連兩天亮燈漲停，還有續航力嗎？一起來研究。昨天法說帶出的變化，是衛星、航太與光通訊業務逐漸擴大，基礎建設與光學產品合計營收占比已超過一半，公司的獲利結構也跟著改變。
過去提到穩懋 (3105-TW)，大家比較熟悉手機功率放大器，也就是幫手機把無線訊號放大、傳出去的晶片。公司替客戶代工的砷化鎵、氮化鎵等化合物半導體，適合用在高頻通訊，現在應用已延伸到衛星和資料中心。客戶對頻率、功率的要求提高，需要配合的製程也更複雜，長期累積的代工經驗就能用在新產品上。
第三季每股盈餘4.55元，較前季明顯增加；合併毛利率回升到37.4%。背後有產能利用率提高，以及高毛利基礎建設產品比重增加的幫助。這季獲利也包含轉投資收益，本業改善則可從毛利率看出來。工廠原本就要負擔設備與人力成本，產出增加、產品組合變好，留下來的利潤就跟著提高。
衛星是這季成長最明顯的一塊。低軌衛星持續發射，新一代規格導入後，衛星與地面之間收發訊號所需的元件也跟著升級。穩懋 (3105-TW)能承接發射端的功率放大器，以及接收微弱訊號時使用的低雜訊放大器等產品。這些需求涵蓋太空端與地面設備，並有不同客戶投入量產，公司已把長期的高頻製程布局轉成實際出貨。
光通訊則先看接收端。光偵測器會把光纖傳來的光訊號轉成電訊號，讓後面的晶片能讀取資料。公司相關產品第三季已進入量產，出貨逐季增加，明年規劃中的產能還會陸續到位。至於提供光源的連續波雷射、搭配調變功能的雷射產品，目前仍在客戶可靠度測試，較明顯的貢獻要看到2028年。眼前已有接收元件放量，發射端則保留後續產品升級的空間。
這次法說，公司對第四季營運仍維持成長看法，衛星新規格與光通訊產能接續到位，有助於支撐手機旺季過後的生意。回答續航力，重點就在這裡：衛星需求已經改善本季的毛利結構，光偵測器又開始增加出貨。穩懋 (3105-TW)後面的成長，有新應用量產與設備投入作為依據，下一階段要由這些產品在營收中占多大比重，來呈現轉型的成果。

Yesterday’s earnings briefing highlighted expanding satellite, aerospace and optical‑communication businesses, with infrastructure and optical products now accounting for more than half of total revenue, and the company’s profit structure shifting accordingly.

When people think of Winstar (3105‑TW), they usually recall its mobile‑phone power amplifiers – chips that boost and transmit wireless signals for phones. The company’s foundry services for gallium‑arsenide, gallium‑nitride and other compound semiconductors are suited for high‑frequency communications and have now extended to satellites and data‑centers. Customers are demanding higher frequencies and power, which requires more complex processes; the long‑term foundry experience can be leveraged for these new products.

Third‑quarter earnings per share were NT$4.55, a clear increase from the prior quarter, and consolidated gross margin rebounded to 37.4%. The improvement stems from higher capacity utilization and a larger share of high‑margin infrastructure products. This quarter’s profit also includes gains from equity investments, but the core business improvement is evident from the margin rise. Factories already bear equipment and labor costs, so higher output and a better product mix translate into higher retained profit.

Satellite is the most obvious growth area this quarter. Low‑Earth‑orbit satellites continue to be launched, and with the introduction of next‑generation specifications, the components needed for uplink and downlink between satellites and ground stations are also being upgraded. Winstar (3105‑TW) can supply power amplifiers for the launch side as well as low‑noise amplifiers used to receive weak signals. These demands cover both space‑borne and ground equipment and involve multiple customers moving to mass production; the company has turned its long‑term high‑frequency process layout into actual shipments.

In optical communications, the focus is first on the receiving side. Photodetectors convert light signals carried by fiber into electrical signals for downstream chips to read data. Winstar’s related products entered mass production in the third quarter, with shipments increasing quarter over quarter, and additional capacity planned for next year will come online gradually. As for continuous‑wave lasers that provide the light source and laser products with modulation capability, they are still undergoing customer reliability testing, with significant contributions not expected until 2028. Receiving components are already scaling, while the transmitting side retains room for future product upgrades.

In this earnings briefing, the company maintained a growth outlook for the fourth quarter, noting that new satellite specifications and the rollout of optical‑communication capacity will help sustain business after the mobile‑phone peak season. Regarding sustainability, the key point is that satellite demand has already improved this quarter’s gross‑margin structure, and photodetector shipments are beginning to rise. Winstar’s future growth rests on mass production of new applications and equipment investments; the next stage will be to see how much of revenue these products will represent, demonstrating the success of the transformation.

items.title: 掛牌滿三個月 長鑫科技正式被納為上證指數第一大權重股
items.title_en: After Three Months Listed, Changxin Technology Officially Added as Top‑Weighted Stock in SSE Composite Index
paras: 根據中證指數公司最新公布數據，中國記憶體晶片龍頭長鑫科技(688825-CN) 28 日正式被納入「上證綜合指數」，權重達 4.67%，躍居該指數第一大權重股，超越農業銀行(601288-CN)(3.83%)與工商銀行(601398-CN)(3.77%)。
同時，長鑫科技也被納入「上證科創板綜合指數」，權重高達 15.74%，同樣位居成分股首位。
長鑫科技於 7 月 27 日在科創板掛牌上市，至 10 月 27 日剛好滿三個月。依據上證綜合指數編製方案，上市以來日均總市值排名前 10 大的證券，上市滿三個月即可計入指數。長鑫科技上市後總市值一度衝破 3 兆元人民幣，長期名列 A 股總市值前茅，順利符合納入條件。
上海證券交易所與中證指數公司於 10 月 26 日實施新修訂的綜合指數編製方案，新增單一樣本權重上限不得超過 15% 的規則。長鑫科技在科創綜指的權重恰好觸及此上限附近，而在上證綜指 4.67% 的權重則遠低於安全警戒線。
受到納入指數利多刺激，長鑫科技近期股價表現相當活躍。10 月 28 日早盤高開 2.74%，盤中漲幅一度突破 4%，最終收盤報每股 44.36 元人民幣，單日上漲 3.16%，近四個交易日累計漲幅逾 12%。
記憶體晶片類股的整體反彈為股價提供了支撐，而指數納入帶來的被動資金配置預期，也被市場視為短期催化因素之一。
paras_en: According to the latest data released by China Securities Index Co., China’s leading memory‑chip maker Changxin Technology (688825‑CN) was formally included in the Shanghai Stock Exchange Composite Index on the 28th, with a weight of 4.67%, making it the index’s largest‑weighted constituent, surpassing Agricultural Bank of China (601288‑CN) at 3.83% and Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (601398‑CN) at 3.77%.
At the same time, Changxin Technology was also added to the SSE STAR Market Composite Index, with a weight of 15.74%, again ranking first among its components.

Changxin Technology was listed on the STAR Market on July 27 and reached the three‑month mark on October 27. Under the SSE Composite Index methodology, securities that rank among the top ten in average daily market capitalization since listing are eligible for inclusion once they have been listed for at least three months. After its debut, Changxin’s total market value briefly exceeded RMB 3 trillion, consistently ranking among the largest A‑share market caps and comfortably meeting the inclusion criteria.

The Shanghai Stock Exchange and China Securities Index Co. implemented a revised Composite Index methodology on October 26, adding a rule that a single constituent’s weight may not exceed 15%. Changxin’s weight in the STAR Market Composite Index is right around this ceiling, while its 4.67% weight in the SSE Composite Index remains well below the safety threshold.

Boosted by the index‑inclusion upside, Changxin’s share price has been very active recently. On the morning of October 28 the stock opened up 2.74%, surged to over a 4% gain intraday, and closed at RMB 44.36 per share, up 3.16% for the day, contributing to a cumulative rise of more than 12% over the past four trading sessions.
The broader rebound in memory‑chip stocks has supported the price, and the expected passive fund inflows from the index inclusion are seen by the market as one of the short‑term catalysts.

items.title: 國泰世華銀看Fed「鷹派暫停」、保留後續緊縮空間 股市震盪恐加劇
items.title_en: Cathay United Bank Sees Fed "Hawkish Pause" and Keeps Room for Further Tightening; Stock Market Volatility May Worsen
paras: 美國聯準會(Fed)公布最新利率決策，聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)以 10 比 2 的票數決議將政策利率維持在 3.75% 至 4.00% 區間，符合市場預期。國泰世華銀行針對 FOMC 會後聲明分析，本次按兵不動屬於「鷹派暫停」，雖然短期利率政策維持穩定，但在通膨高檔及地緣政治風險下，Fed 仍保留了後續的緊縮空間。預期短線股市震盪加劇，將回歸獲利與財務基本面。

國泰世華銀行指出，本次會議表決中，官員 Lisa Cook 與 Beth Hammack 主張應升息一碼，顯示內部對通膨仍存戒心。Fed 主席華許(Kevin Warsh)會後表示，美國經濟在強勁消費與企業投資帶動下持續擴張，失業率低於一年前；然而，通膨已連續六年高於 2% 目標，現階段仍處於「資訊豐富期」，需要更多時間與數據來評估未來的貨幣政策走向。此外，Fed 也宣布調整未來的利率決策會議次數，2027 年將調整為 7 次，2028 年則降至 6 次。
針對 10 月暫停升息的主因，國泰世華銀行分析有兩大關鍵，首先，本輪通膨主要由能源供給壓力引發，Fed 意在避免過度緊縮對實體經濟造成衝擊。其次，先前美債殖利率飆升至近年高點，市場早已反應升息預期，進而帶動整體金融與信用環境緊縮，減少了 Fed 進一步大幅升息的迫切性。
不過，國泰世華銀行提醒，考量美伊衝突仍具高度不確定性，且通膨改善幅度有限，今年 12 月與明年 3 月仍有相當大的升息可能性，後續路徑將視地緣政治變化及原油運輸恢復狀況而定。
至於股市方面，國泰世華銀行認為，在高利率與高評價面雙重壓力下，市場短期波動恐將放大。近期市場開始審視科技與 AI 投資的回收進度及融資成本壓力，科技股短期內不排除持續震盪。
不過，壓力將主要集中於高槓桿企業，大型科技龍頭與雲端服務供應商(CSP)憑藉穩健的現金流與獲利能力，仍有能力支撐 AI 投資。中長期而言，AI 發展大趨勢不變，市場焦點將從「評價面擴張」轉向「獲利成長與財務品質」。
債市與匯市部分，近期科技股修正誘發避險資金流入債市，帶動美債殖利率自高點回落。然而，受 Fed 高利率政策、美國財政赤字加劇、公債供給增加及企業融資需求等因素影響，長端利率中樞預計仍將維持在高檔。匯市方面，在聯準會維持鷹派政策的支撐下，美元短期內仍將維持相對偏強的走勢。
paras_en: The U.S. Federal Reserve announced its latest rate decision, with the Federal Open Market Committee voting 10‑2 to keep the policy rate in the 3.75%‑4.00% range, in line with market expectations. Cathay United Bank’s post‑FOMC statement analysis characterises this hold as a “hawkish pause.” While short‑term rate policy remains stable, the Fed retains room for further tightening amid high inflation and geopolitical risks. The bank expects short‑term market volatility to intensify, with a return to focus on earnings and financial fundamentals.

Cathay United Bank noted that in the vote, officials Lisa Cook and Beth Hammack advocated for a one‑point rate hike, indicating lingering internal concerns about inflation. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh said after the meeting that the U.S. economy continues to expand on the back of strong consumer spending and corporate investment, with unemployment lower than a year ago; however, inflation has stayed above the 2% target for six consecutive years and the economy is still in an “information‑rich period,” requiring more time and data to assess future monetary policy. The Fed also announced it will adjust the number of policy meetings, moving to seven meetings in 2027 and six in 2028.

Regarding the main reasons for the October pause, Cathay United Bank identified two key factors. First, the current inflation surge is driven mainly by energy‑supply pressures, and the Fed aims to avoid an overly aggressive tightening that could hurt the real economy. Second, U.S. Treasury yields had already spiked to near‑recent highs, prompting the market to price in rate hikes and tightening overall financial and credit conditions, reducing the urgency for the Fed to raise rates further.

Nevertheless, Cathay United Bank warned that the ongoing U.S.–Iran conflict remains highly uncertain and inflation improvements are modest, leaving a sizable chance of another rate hike in December this year or March next year. The subsequent path will depend on geopolitical developments and the restoration of oil‑transport flows.

On equities, the bank believes that the dual pressure of high rates and lofty valuations could amplify short‑term market swings. Recently, investors have begun scrutinising the rollout of technology and AI investments and the pressure from financing costs, so tech stocks could continue to oscillate in the near term.

However, the pressure will mainly affect highly leveraged firms. Large‑cap tech leaders and cloud‑service providers (CSPs) enjoy solid cash flows and earnings power, enabling them to sustain AI spending. Over the medium to long term, the AI growth trend remains unchanged, and market focus will shift from “valuation expansion” to “profit growth and financial quality.”

In the bond and currency markets, the recent tech‑stock pullback has prompted a flight to safety into bonds, pulling U.S. Treasury yields down from their peaks. Yet, due to the Fed’s high‑rate stance, widening U.S. fiscal deficits, increased sovereign‑debt supply and corporate financing needs, long‑term rates are expected to stay elevated. In the FX market, with the Fed maintaining a hawkish policy, the dollar is likely to remain relatively strong in the short term.

paras: 今天大盤又向下震盪，一度重挫，但穩懋 (3105-TW)連兩天亮燈漲停，還有續航力嗎？一起來研究。昨天法說帶出的變化，是衛星、航太與光通訊業務逐漸擴大，基礎建設與光學產品合計營收占比已超過一半，公司的獲利結構也跟著改變。
過去提到穩懋 (3105-TW)，大家比較熟悉手機功率放大器，也就是幫手機把無線訊號放大、傳出去的晶片。公司替客戶代工的砷化鎵、氮化鎵等化合物半導體，適合用在高頻通訊，現在應用已延伸到衛星和資料中心。客戶對頻率、功率的要求提高，需要配合的製程也更複雜，長期累積的代工經驗就能用在新產品上。
第三季每股盈餘4.55元，較前季明顯增加；合併毛利率回升到37.4%。背後有產能利用率提高，以及高毛利基礎建設產品比重增加的幫助。這季獲利也包含轉投資收益，本業改善則可從毛利率看出來。工廠原本就要負擔設備與人力成本，產出增加、產品組合變好，留下來的利潤就跟著提高。
衛星是這季成長最明顯的一塊。低軌衛星持續發射，新一代規格導入後，衛星與地面之間收發訊號所需的元件也跟著升級。穩懋 (3105-TW)能承接發射端的功率放大器，以及接收微弱訊號時使用的低雜訊放大器等產品。這些需求涵蓋太空端與地面設備，並有不同客戶投入量產，公司已把長期的高頻製程布局轉成實際出貨。
光通訊則先看接收端。光偵測器會把光纖傳來的光訊號轉成電訊號，讓後面的晶片能讀取資料。公司相關產品第三季已進入量產，出貨逐季增加，明年規劃中的產能還會陸續到位。至於提供光源的連續波雷射、搭配調變功能的雷射產品，目前仍在客戶可靠度測試，較明顯的貢獻要看到2028年。眼前已有接收元件放量，發射端則保留後續產品升級的空間。
這次法說，公司對第四季營運仍維持成長看法，衛星新規格與光通訊產能接續到位，有助於支撐手機旺季過後的生意。回答續航力，重點就在這裡：衛星需求已經改善本季的毛利結構，光偵測器又開始增加出貨。穩懋 (3105-TW)後面的成長，有新應用量產與設備投入作為依據，下一階段要由這些產品在營收中占多大比重，來呈現轉型的成果。

paras_en: The market swung down again today, plunging at one point, but Winstar (3105‑TW) has hit the limit-up for two consecutive days. Does it still have momentum? Let’s take a look. Yesterday’s earnings briefing highlighted expanding satellite, aerospace and optical‑communication businesses, with infrastructure and optical products now accounting for more than half of total revenue, and the company’s profit structure shifting accordingly.

When people think of Winstar (3105‑TW), they usually recall its mobile‑phone power amplifiers – chips that boost and transmit wireless signals for phones. The company’s foundry services for gallium‑arsenide, gallium‑nitride and other compound semiconductors are suited for high‑frequency communications and have now extended to satellites and data‑centers. Customers are demanding higher frequencies and power, which requires more complex processes; the long‑term foundry experience can be leveraged for these new products.

Third‑quarter earnings per share were NT$4.55, a clear increase from the prior quarter, and consolidated gross margin rebounded to 37.4%. The improvement stems from higher capacity utilization and a larger share of high‑margin infrastructure products. This quarter’s profit also includes gains from equity investments, but the core business improvement is evident from the margin rise. Factories already bear equipment and labor costs, so higher output and a better product mix translate into higher retained profit.

Satellite is the most obvious growth area this quarter. Low‑Earth‑orbit satellites continue to be launched, and with the introduction of next‑generation specifications, the components needed for uplink and downlink between satellites and ground stations are also being upgraded. Winstar (3105‑TW) can supply power amplifiers for the launch side as well as low‑noise amplifiers used to receive weak signals. These demands cover both space‑borne and ground equipment and involve multiple customers moving to mass production; the company has turned its long‑term high‑frequency process layout into actual shipments.

In optical communications, the focus is first on the receiving side. Photodetectors convert light signals carried by fiber into electrical signals for downstream chips to read data. Winstar’s related products entered mass production in the third quarter, with shipments increasing quarter over quarter, and additional capacity planned for next year will come online gradually. As for continuous‑wave lasers that provide the light source and laser products with modulation capability, they are still undergoing customer reliability testing, with significant contributions not expected until 2028. Receiving components are already scaling, while the transmitting side retains room for future product upgrades.

In this earnings briefing, the company maintained a growth outlook for the fourth quarter, noting that new satellite specifications and the rollout of optical‑communication capacity will help sustain business after the mobile‑phone peak season. Regarding sustainability, the key point is that satellite demand has already improved this quarter’s gross‑margin structure, and photodetector shipments are beginning to rise. Winstar’s future growth rests on mass production of new applications and equipment investments; the next stage will be to see how much of revenue these products will represent, demonstrating the success of the transformation.

items.title_en: The Real‑Life Figure Behind “The Big Short” Exposes Hidden Numbers in Anthropic’s Prospectus: Invisible Compute Commitment of $537 billion
paras: 「這份S-1裡最該上頭條的數字，從來沒有以單一金額出現過。」《大賣空》原型人物貝瑞(Michael Burry)在最新Substack文章中如此說道，他並將Anthropic招股書附註裡散落的算力合約逐一加總，算出約5370億美元的計算與基礎設施承諾，並直言這才是這家公司真正的財務重心。
這位傳奇投資人拆解的明細包括：谷歌1145億、亞馬遜1100億、微軟449億美元採購承諾；博通1612億美元TPU機櫃租賃；新創雲廠商Lambda與Nscale合計約860億；超微預計超200億。若計入尚在敲定的谷歌TPU追加協議(1250億至1500億)與SpaceX最高1205億美元合作，總承諾可逼近8000億美元，超過過去一年營收的20倍。
Anthropic週一(26日)公開遞交S-1，擬以代號「ANT」在那斯達克全球精選市場上市，由高盛與摩根士丹利主承銷，發行股數與價格區間尚未公布。
貝瑞指出，營收成長正與龐大承諾同步堆高：2026年前兩季環比增速曾達132%、144%，第三季降至約45%，單季營收近169億美元；8、9月月增率只剩3%至7%，每1美元算力產出的營收也從2.08美元滑落到1.70美元，是該指標首次轉弱。
更關鍵的是合約性質，多數協議屬「take-or-pay(照付不議)」，也就是無論實際用量多少，Anthropic都須按期付款並補足差額。
貝瑞還點出資金循環：亞馬遜、谷歌共向Anthropic出資約410億美元，這筆錢很大一部分又透過算力採購流回雲廠商；超大规模業者同時掌握「出資方、供應商、銷售渠道、股東」四重身分，並經雲市場收取Anthropic約48%的營收。
投資人Nicholas Mugalli認為，約5000億美元算力已鎖進各大晶片廠，代表AI基建才剛起步。
《Benzinga》報導也提醒，807億美元淨虧損多數來自可轉換票據的非現金會計費用，營業虧損實為6.93億美元。
貝瑞也預期Anthropic路演前S-1會再修訂，補入Q3細節與10月營收運行率，「結果其實已經清楚了」。
paras_en: Michael Burry, the real‑life inspiration for “The Big Short,” wrote in a recent Substack post that the most headline‑worthy figure in the S‑1 has never appeared as a single amount. He added up the scattered compute contracts in Anthropic’s filing and calculated roughly $537 billion in computing and infrastructure commitments, saying that this is the company’s true financial focus.

The breakdown he detailed includes procurement commitments of $114.5 billion from Google, $110 billion from Amazon and $44.9 billion from Microsoft; Broadcom’s $161.2 billion TPU rack leasing; startup cloud providers Lambda and Nscale combined at about $86 billion; and AMD’s expected commitment of over $20 billion. If the still‑pending Google TPU add‑on agreement ($125‑$150 billion) and a maximum $120.5 billion partnership with SpaceX are added, total commitments approach $800 billion, more than 20 times last year’s revenue.

Anthropic filed its S‑1 on Monday (the 26th), planning to list under the ticker “ANT” on the Nasdaq Global Select Market, with Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley as lead underwriters. The number of shares and price range have not yet been disclosed.

Burry points out that revenue growth is climbing in step with the massive commitments: year‑over‑year growth in the first two quarters of 2026 hit 132% and 144%, then fell to about 45% in the third quarter, with quarterly revenue near $16.9 billion; August‑September month‑over‑month growth slipped to just 3%‑7%, and revenue per $1 of compute dropped from $2.08 to $1.70, marking the first weakening of that metric.
More crucial is the nature of the contracts—most are “take‑or‑pay,” meaning Anthropic must make scheduled payments and cover any shortfall regardless of actual usage.

Burry also highlights the capital flow: Amazon and Google together have invested about $41 billion in Anthropic, a large portion of which cycles back to cloud vendors through compute purchases. These hyperscale players simultaneously occupy four roles—investor, supplier, sales channel and shareholder—and collect roughly 48% of Anthropic’s revenue via the cloud market.
Investor Nicholas Mugalli believes roughly $500 billion of compute capacity is already locked into major chip makers, indicating that AI infrastructure is only just getting started.
Benzinga reports that the $80.7 billion net loss is largely due to non‑cash accounting charges on convertible notes, with the actual operating loss standing at $693 million.
Burry also expects Anthropic’s S‑1 to be revised before the roadshow to incorporate Q3 details and the October revenue run‑rate, saying “the result is actually already clear.”

items.title: 「股神」也失手？巴菲特最後一筆重大投資恐遇挫、Alphabet持股市值蒸發70億美元
items.title_en: Even the 'Oracle of Omaha' Makes a Mistake? Buffett’s Last Major Investment Faces Setback, Alphabet Shares Lose $7 Billion in Market Value
paras: 股神巴菲特（Warren Buffett）卸任波克夏(BRK.A-US) 董事長前的最後一筆重大股票投資，目前面臨考驗。Google(GOOGL-US) 母公司 Alphabet 第三季財報表現不如市場預期，股價盤後大幅下挫，使波克夏先前大舉買進的持股價值縮水。
根據《巴隆周刊》報導，波克夏在2026年上半年持續加碼 Alphabet，其中包括6月初參與該公司規模850億美元的股票增資，以每股約350美元買進價值100億美元的股票。
Alphabet公佈的第三季每股收益為2.12美元，低於去年同期的2.87美元，也低於市場普遍預期的約3美元。受此影響，Alphabet 有表決權股票在盤後交易中下跌11%，報每股288美元。
此外，由於大舉投入人工智慧（AI）相關資本支出，Alphabet 的自由現金流為負90億美元。
巴菲特7月接受《CNBC》訪問時曾表示，買進 Alphabet 股票是他本人的決定。巴菲特已於2025年底卸下波克夏執行長職務，但當時仍保留董事長職位，近期則已將董事長職務交給兒子霍華・巴菲特（Howard Buffett）。
報導指出，波克夏持有 Alphabet 股票的平均成本無法確定，但很可能高於每股300美元，甚至可能接近每股320美元。
波克夏於2025年第三季買進1,800萬股 Alphabet 股票，當時股價平均約225美元；2026年第一季再買進約4,000萬股，平均股價約315美元；第二季則買進近5,000萬股，其中近3,000萬股來自每股約350美元的承銷發行。
截至6月30日，波克夏共持有1.06億股 Alphabet 股票，包括有表決權及無表決權股份。
以盤後股價計算，波克夏持有的 Alphabet 股權目前價值約300億美元，低於6月高峰時的370億美元。Alphabet 是波克夏第四大股票持倉，排名僅次於蘋果(AAPL-US) 、美國運通(AXP-US) 及可口可樂(KO-US) 。
《巴隆》6月曾指出，考慮到 Alphabet 股價在前一年已大幅上漲，波克夏進場時機可能偏晚。
波克夏過去曾公布旗下前15大股票持倉及其成本基礎，但在2020年代初期停止這麼做。這使外界更難計算波克夏許多新近投資的獲利或虧損，也讓市場難以追究管理層在股票投資方面的決策責任。
報導指出，執行長阿貝爾（Greg Abel）應考慮在2027年發布的下一封年度股東信中，恢復公布股票持倉及成本基礎的表格。
paras_en: The last major stock purchase made by Warren Buffett before stepping down as chairman of Berkshire Hathaway (BRK.A-US) is now under scrutiny. Alphabet’s (GOOGL-US) third‑quarter earnings fell short of market expectations, causing its stock to drop sharply in after‑hours trading and eroding the value of Berkshire’s sizeable holdings.

According to Barron's, Berkshire continued to add to its Alphabet stake in the first half of 2026, including a June‑early participation in the company’s $85 billion equity offering, buying $10 billion of shares at roughly $350 per share.

Alphabet reported a Q3 earnings per share of $2.12, lower than last year’s $2.87 and below the market’s roughly $3 expectation. As a result, Alphabet’s voting shares fell 11% in after‑hours trading, trading at $288 per share.
In addition, Alphabet’s free cash flow turned negative $9 billion due to large capital expenditures on artificial‑intelligence (AI) initiatives.

During a CNBC interview in July, Buffett said buying Alphabet stock was his personal decision. He stepped down as Berkshire’s CEO at the end of 2025 but remained chairman until recently, when he handed the role to his son Howard Buffett.
Reports indicate Berkshire’s average cost basis for Alphabet shares is unclear but likely above $300 per share, possibly approaching $320 per share.

Berkshire bought 18 million Alphabet shares in Q3 2025 at an average price of about $225 per share; in Q1 2026 it purchased roughly 40 million shares at an average of $315 per share; in Q2 it bought nearly 50 million shares, of which about 30 million came from an underwritten offering at roughly $350 per share.
As of June 30, Berkshire owned a total of 106 million Alphabet shares, including both voting and non‑voting shares.

Using the after‑hours price, Berkshire’s Alphabet holdings are currently worth about $30 billion, down from a peak of $37 billion in June. Alphabet is Berkshire’s fourth‑largest holding, behind Apple (AAPL‑US), American Express (AXP‑US) and Coca‑Cola (KO‑US).
Barron's noted in June that, given Alphabet’s sharp price rise the previous year, Berkshire’s entry timing may have been late.

Berkshire previously disclosed its top 15 holdings and cost basis, but stopped doing so in the early 2020s. This makes it harder for outsiders to calculate the gains or losses on many recent investments and hampers accountability for management’s investment decisions.
The report suggests CEO Greg Abel should consider reinstating the disclosure of share holdings and cost basis in the 2027 annual letter to shareholders.

items.title: 財測釋利多｜甲骨文（ORCL）AI燒錢何時回收？現金流轉正時程曝光，股價大漲11%
items.title_en: Financial Forecast Highlights Benefits: When Will Oracle (ORCL) AI Cash Burn Turn Positive? Cash Flow Recovery Timeline Revealed, Stock Jumps 11%
paras: 2026年10月29日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ AI資料中心持續擴建，投資人最想知道的，已不只是科技公司能接到多少訂單，而是投入的資金何時能夠回收。
甲骨文Oracle(ORCL-US)美國時間10月28日更新中長期財測，預計自由現金流於2028會計年度下半年轉正，2029會計年度達至少300億美元，並為後續額外籌資設定上限。消息緩解市場對AI投資資金需求的疑慮，帶動當日股價收盤大漲約11%。
(圖片來源:優分析產業資料庫)

資本支出高峰在前，現金回收目標在後
甲骨文表示，2027與2028會計年度將處於資本支出高峰，2029會計年度起支出預計下降。公司目標是在2028會計年度下半年實現正自由現金流，並於2029會計年度開始，以自身產生的資金支應成長。
自由現金流，可以理解為營運產生的現金，扣除資本支出後，還能留下多少資金。對大規模建置AI資料中心的公司而言，即使營收與帳面獲利增加，只要購買設備、建置機房的支出更大，現金仍可能持續流出。
因此，甲骨文提出轉正時間表，重要之處不在於宣告「燒錢已經結束」，而是讓投資人有更明確的時間基準，檢驗這輪擴張能否開始產生現金回報。
需要注意的是，甲骨文會計年度於每年5月底結束，文中的2028、2029會計年度，不能直接等同曆年。

額外籌資上限200億美元，不代表整輪投資只需這筆錢
除了現金回收時程，甲骨文也表示，至2030會計年度的投資週期，額外向資本市場籌集的資金將以200億美元為限，目前預計股權與債務融資各約100億美元。
但這項上限不包含既有債務再融資，也不包含公司已在2027會計年度第一季完成的200億美元股票籌資。換句話說，不能把它解讀成整輪AI擴張只需要籌資200億美元。
對股東而言，後續應觀察實際增資與舉債是否符合規劃，以及取得的資金能否順利轉化為可使用的運算容量、客戶收入與現金流。

雲端基礎設施營收翻倍，成長已有實際數字支撐
甲骨文先前公布的2027會計年度第一季財報，已呈現AI基礎設施需求帶來的成長。
當季總營收約193億美元，年增30%；總雲端營收約116億美元，年增62%。其中，雲端基礎設施業務營收約74億美元，年增121%，明顯快於雲端應用業務的10%增幅。
這意味著，甲骨文的擴張並非只有遠期想像，運算與雲端基礎設施需求已反映在收入上。但營收成長只是第一步，新增資料中心能否有效利用、設備投入能否創造足夠報酬，才會決定最終能留下多少現金。

2030財年營收拚2,250億美元，仍是目標而非保證
甲骨文此次提出，2030會計年度營收目標至少2,250億美元，調整後營業利益率超過40%，調整後每股盈餘超過21美元；公司也重申2027會計年度營收至少900億美元、調整後EPS為8.10美元的展望。
不過，中長期財測仍建立在資料中心建置、客戶需求與成本控制等假設之上。若設備交付、產能使用或客戶專案進度不如預期，收入與現金回收時程也可能改變。
因此，不能只看2030年的營收目標，更要逐季追蹤營業現金流、資本支出與新增融資需求，確認公司是否朝規劃方向前進。

股價先反映期待，下一步看現金流兌現
甲骨文這次財測更新，讓AI擴張故事多了一個可驗證的焦點：投資高峰之後，公司能否減少對外部資金的依賴，開始靠自身營運支撐成長。
股價大漲11%，反映市場對這份路線圖的正面反應，但並不代表投資回收已經完成。接下來真正重要的，是資本支出能否按計畫度過高峰，以及自由現金流能否如期轉正。
對甲骨文而言，AI競賽的下一道考題，已不只是「能建多少資料中心」，而是這些投入最終能為股東留下多少現金。

paras_en: October 29, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – As AI data centers continue to expand, investors are no longer only interested in how many orders tech companies can secure, but when the invested capital can be recouped.

Oracle (ORCL-US) updated its mid‑to‑long‑term financial outlook on October 28 U.S. time, projecting that free cash flow will turn positive in the second half of fiscal 2028 and reach at least $30 billion in fiscal 2029, while setting an upper limit for additional fundraising. The news eased market concerns about AI investment funding needs and drove the stock up about 11% at the close that day.
(Image source: U‑Analysis industry database)

Capital spending peaks first, cash‑recovery targets follow. Oracle said fiscal 2027 and 2028 will be the peak years for capital expenditures, with spending expected to decline from fiscal 2029 onward. The company aims to achieve positive free cash flow in the second half of fiscal 2028 and to fund growth from its own cash starting fiscal 2029.

Free cash flow can be understood as the cash generated from operations after deducting capital expenditures. For companies building AI data centers at scale, even if revenue and accounting profit rise, cash can still flow out if equipment purchases and data‑center construction costs exceed those gains.

Therefore, Oracle’s announced turnaround timetable is important not because it declares “the money‑burning phase is over,” but because it gives investors a clearer time benchmark to assess whether this expansion round can start delivering cash returns.
It should be noted that Oracle’s fiscal year ends at the end of May each year, so the fiscal 2028 and 2029 mentioned in the article do not correspond directly to calendar years.

An additional fundraising cap of $20 billion does not mean the entire AI expansion requires only that amount. Oracle also said that for the investment cycle through fiscal 2030, the total amount it may raise from capital markets will be capped at $20 billion, with roughly $10 billion each planned from equity and debt financing.

However, this cap excludes refinancing of existing debt and does not include the $20 billion equity raise that the company completed in the first quarter of fiscal 2027. In other words, it should not be interpreted as the whole AI expansion needing only $20 billion of new capital.

Shareholders should watch whether actual equity issuances and debt borrowings stay within the plan, and whether the raised funds can be smoothly converted into usable compute capacity, customer revenue, and cash flow.
Cloud infrastructure revenue has doubled, with growth now backed by concrete numbers. Oracle’s previously released Q1 fiscal 2027 results already show growth driven by AI infrastructure demand.

For the quarter, total revenue was about $19.3 billion, up 30% year over year; total cloud revenue was about $11.6 billion, up 62% YoY. Cloud infrastructure revenue was roughly $7.4 billion, up 121% YoY, clearly outpacing the 10% growth in cloud applications.

This means Oracle’s expansion is not just a distant vision; compute and cloud infrastructure demand is already reflected in revenue. Yet revenue growth is only the first step—whether new data centers can be efficiently utilized and whether equipment investments generate sufficient returns will determine how much cash ultimately remains.

The company set a fiscal 2030 revenue target of at least $225 billion, adjusted operating margin above 40%, and adjusted EPS above $21. Oracle also reaffirmed its outlook for fiscal 2027 revenue of at least $90 billion and adjusted EPS of $8.10.

However, the mid‑to‑long‑term outlook still rests on assumptions about data‑center builds, customer demand, and cost control. If equipment deliveries, capacity utilization, or customer project timelines fall short, both revenue and cash‑recovery timing could change.
Thus, one should not focus solely on the 2030 revenue goal but also track quarterly operating cash flow, capital spending, and new financing needs to confirm the company is moving as planned.

Oracle’s latest outlook adds a verifiable focus to the AI expansion story: after the investment peak, can the company reduce reliance on external capital and start supporting growth with its own operations?

The 11% stock surge reflects the market’s positive reaction to this roadmap, but it does not mean the investment payback is complete. The real test ahead is whether capital spending can pass the peak as scheduled and whether free cash flow turns positive as expected.
For Oracle, the next challenge in the AI race is no longer just “how many data centers can be built,” but how much cash these investments ultimately leave for shareholders.

items.title: Google股價恐遭遇多年來最嚴重的下跌？營收、獲利雙雙不如預期  盤後暴跌9.4%
items.title_en: Is Google Stock Facing Its Worst Decline in Years? Revenue and Profit Both Miss Expectations, After-Hours Drop 9.4%
paras: Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 周三（28日）公布第三季財報，營收與每股盈餘雙雙低於市場預期，儘管Google Cloud營收年增逾一倍、表現亮眼，但搜尋與廣告業務未達市場期待，加上人工智慧（AI）基礎設施支出持續攀升，引發投資人對AI投資回報及核心搜尋業務成長動能的疑慮，Alphabet股價盤後重挫逾9%。
根據《MarketWatch》報導，財報顯示，Alphabet第三季營收年增25%至1,276億美元，低於分析師預期的1,280億美元；每股盈餘為2.12美元，也不及市場預估的3.02美元。
每股盈餘低於預期，主要受到一筆86億美元的股權投資帳面損失拖累，公司將這筆損失歸因於對SpaceX(SPCX-US) 的投資。
Alphabet股價周三盤後下跌9.4%。若跌勢延續至周四正常交易時段，將創下自2023年10月單日下跌9.5%以來最大跌幅。
Google Cloud成為本季財報亮點，營收年增103%至307.1億美元，大幅超越華爾街預期的288億美元。然而，搜尋與廣告等核心業務表現不如預期，未能抵銷其他業務的疲弱。
Bernstein分析師Mark Shmulik在周三發布的報告中指出，Alphabet本季財報初步呈現的負面因素遠多於正面消息。Google搜尋營收年增12%，低於第二季的17%，成長幅度明顯放緩。
值得注意的是，Google搜尋查詢量的成長幅度已達5年來最高水準，卻未能帶動搜尋營收同步加速。
Alphabet在財報電話會議中表示，本季搜尋營收受到匯率波動影響。此外，AI模式（AI Mode）的平均查詢長度約為傳統搜尋的3倍，但目前變現能力仍較低。
Google Cloud雖然大幅超越華爾街整體預期，Shmulik指出，機構投資人在財報公布前，原本期待該業務成長率超過115%，因此實際表現仍未完全滿足市場的高標準。
Alphabet持續投入大量資金建置AI基礎設施，第三季相關支出達514億美元。由於設備與資料中心投入的資金超過公司業務所創造的現金，Alphabet當季自由現金流轉為負91億美元。
Direxion產品與策略資深副總裁Ryan Lee在周三發布的報告中表示，這份財報顯示，Google仍面臨如何將AI投資轉化為營收的挑戰。
他形容目前的情況是「糟糕的組合」，並指出，若AI投資遲遲無法變現，或核心業務未能成長以彌補支出，持續燒錢將愈來愈難以合理化。
市場另一項隱憂，是AI競爭者可能逐步侵蝕Google的搜尋市場。
法國巴黎銀行（BNP Paribas）分析師Nick Jones在周三的報告中指出，Alphabet最新財報可能再次引發市場對OpenAI旗下ChatGPT及Meta(META-US) Muse代理工具搶占Google搜尋業務的擔憂。
投資人尤其關注AI代理購物服務的發展。如果消費者未來主要透過AI代理瀏覽網頁、尋找商品及完成購物，傳統搜尋引擎的使用方式可能改變，進而衝擊Google仰賴搜尋流量的廣告營收。
paras_en: Alphabet, Google’s parent company (GOOGL-US), released its third‑quarter earnings on Wednesday (the 28th). Both revenue and earnings per share fell short of market expectations. Although Google Cloud’s revenue more than doubled year‑over‑year and shone brightly, the search and advertising businesses missed the mark, and rising AI infrastructure spending has sparked investor worries about AI ROI and the growth momentum of core search, sending Alphabet’s stock down more than 9% in after‑hours trading.

According to MarketWatch, the report showed third‑quarter revenue rose 25% year‑over‑year to $127.6 billion, below analysts’ forecast of $128.0 billion; earnings per share came in at $2.12, also missing the consensus estimate of $3.02.
The EPS shortfall was largely due to an $8.6 billion equity‑investment write‑down, which the company attributed to its stake in SpaceX (SPCX‑US).
Alphabet’s shares fell 9.4% after hours on Wednesday. If the decline continues into Thursday’s regular session, it would be the steepest single‑day drop since the 9.5% slide on October 2023.

Google Cloud was the standout of the quarter, with revenue up 103% year‑over‑year to $30.71 billion, far exceeding Wall Street’s $28.8 billion expectation. However, core businesses such as search and advertising underperformed, failing to offset weakness elsewhere.

Bernstein analyst Mark Shmulik noted in a Wednesday report that the negative factors in Alphabet’s quarterly results far outweigh the positives. Google search revenue grew 12% year‑over‑year, down from a 17% rise in Q2, indicating a clear slowdown.
It is noteworthy that Google search query growth hit its highest rate in five years, yet this did not translate into faster search‑revenue growth.

During the earnings call, Alphabet said the quarter’s search revenue was hit by currency fluctuations. The average query length for AI Mode is about three times that of traditional search, but its monetization remains low.

Although Google Cloud far outperformed overall Wall Street expectations, Shmulik pointed out that institutional investors had been hoping for a growth rate above 115% before the results, so the actual performance still fell short of the lofty market bar.

Alphabet continues to pour massive capital into AI infrastructure, with related spending reaching $51.4 billion in the quarter. Because equipment and data‑center outlays exceeded cash generated by the business, free cash flow turned negative $9.1 billion for the period.
Direxion senior vice president of products and strategy Ryan Lee said in a Wednesday note that the results show Google still faces the challenge of turning AI investments into revenue.

He described the situation as a “bad combination,” warning that if AI spending remains un‑monetized or core businesses fail to grow enough to offset the outlay, the relentless cash burn will become increasingly hard to justify.
Another market concern is that AI rivals could gradually erode Google’s search market share.

BNP Paribas analyst Nick Jones wrote in a Wednesday report that Alphabet’s latest results may reignite worries that OpenAI’s ChatGPT and Meta’s (META-US) Muse agents could chip away at Google’s search business.

Investors are especially watching the development of AI‑driven shopping agents. If consumers increasingly browse the web, discover products and complete purchases through AI agents, the way traditional search engines are used could shift, threatening Google’s ad revenue that relies on search traffic.

items.title: 華爾街投資焦點轉向自由現金流！AI支出飆升逼科技巨頭縮編
items.title_en: Wall Street Investment Focus Shifts to Free Cash Flow as AI Spending Soars, Prompting Tech Giants to Cut Costs
paras: 人工智慧(AI)基礎建設投資持續升溫，但華爾街評估大型科技公司的標準正在改變。彭博科技節目主持人Ed Ludlow指出，投資人如今不只關注企業在AI領域投入多少資金，更在意鉅額支出後究竟能留下多少自由現金流。隨著資料中心、晶片與雲端基礎設施投資快速增加，科技巨頭開始面臨成長布局與財務紀律的雙重考驗，微軟(Microsoft) (MSFT-US)向約6萬名員工提出自願買斷方案、甲骨文(Oracle) (ORCL-US)縮減人力，以及Meta Platforms (META-US)自由現金流轉負，都凸顯市場對資金使用效率的要求升高。
Ed Ludlow近日在彭博電台表示，「華爾街現在在意自由現金流，真的非常在意。」他指出，蘋果(Apple) (AAPL-US)與輝達(NVIDIA) (NVDA-US)等現金充裕的企業，近期股價表現相對強勢；相較之下，微軟、Alphabet (GOOGL-US)與Meta的股價表現較為落後。這種差異顯示，市場正重新評估不同企業投入AI的成本、現金流承受能力，以及投資何時能轉化為實際回報。
大型科技公司正陷入兩難。一方面，投資人希望企業持續擴大AI布局，避免在競爭中落後；另一方面，資料中心建設、先進晶片採購與雲端運算服務都需要龐大資本，持續消耗現金。當投資規模增加、自由現金流減少，企業就必須尋找其他節流方式，否則可能面臨獲利品質下降、融資成本上升及股東信心轉弱等壓力。
微軟近期向約6萬名員工提出自願買斷方案，規模約占全球員工總數的27%，成為這股成本控制趨勢的代表案例。不過，實際有多少員工接受方案仍未確定。據報導，Xbox、Windows、Copilot及財務等團隊可能納入適用範圍，部分資料中心員工則不在其中。微軟表示，這項方案旨在協助組織配合業務需求調整，但公司並未直接將措施歸因於AI支出。
微軟的現金流壓力並非源自營運停滯。公司上一財年營運現金流成長34%，但基礎設施支出增加得更快，使扣除投資後可自由運用的現金受到擠壓。這也反映AI產業當前的核心問題：即使營收與營運現金流持續成長，只要資本支出攀升速度更快，投資人仍可能對現金流品質產生疑慮。
甲骨文則是另一個例子。公司今年大幅縮減人力，以降低成本並為AI資料中心擴張騰出資金。投資銀行TD Cowen估計，若裁減2萬至3萬個職位，甲骨文每年可能增加80億至100億美元的自由現金流空間。甲骨文先前在自由現金流轉負時，股價曾受到市場明顯懲罰，顯示投資人對資本支出與現金回收時程愈來愈敏感。
Meta同樣面臨壓力。公司上一季自由現金流轉為負值，最新財報顯示，員工人數較去年同期減少15%。不過，Ed Ludlow提醒，市場對不同企業的反應並不一致，即使財務指標相似，股價仍可能因市場對其成長前景、投資策略及執行能力的評價不同而出現差異。他形容市場反應具有反覆性，投資人並非單純依照自由現金流正負來決定買賣。
成本壓力也正延伸至AI資料中心的融資市場。彭博另一篇報導指出，至少18筆資料中心融資的收益率已達雙位數，顯示貸款機構與投資人對AI基礎建設融資的風險更加謹慎。當企業持續借款建設資料中心、採購運算晶片與購買雲端容量，資金成本升高可能進一步壓縮未來投資報酬。
這不代表AI需求已經消失，而是資本市場開始要求更清楚的財務證據。過去，企業只要宣布擴大AI支出，就可能被視為積極布局；如今，市場更在意支出是否能帶來營收成長、利潤改善，以及可持續的現金流。企業若只追求投資規模，卻無法說明回收期與資金來源，就可能遭到更嚴格的估值檢驗。
微軟與Alphabet於10月28日美股收盤後公布財報，市場將密切檢視兩家公司AI投資的實際回報，尤其是雲端業務成長、資本支出及現金流展望。對微軟而言，投資人除了關注Azure與AI服務的成長，也將評估基礎設施支出是否持續快於營運現金流；Alphabet則須證明AI投資能帶動搜尋、雲端及其他業務的商業化成果。
整體而言，華爾街並未放棄AI投資，而是開始從「投入多少」轉向「能賺回多少」。微軟買斷員工、甲骨文縮編，以及Meta自由現金流轉負，反映科技巨頭正在調整成本結構，以支應高昂的AI基礎設施投資。接下來，市場將更重視企業能否維持成長，同時控制資本支出、改善現金流並證明AI投資的經濟效益。對大型科技公司而言，AI競賽不再只有技術與算力之爭，也逐漸成為現金流管理與資本配置能力的較量。
paras_en: AI infrastructure investment continues to heat up, but Wall Street's criteria for evaluating large tech companies are changing. Bloomberg tech show host Ed Ludlow noted that investors now care not only about how much companies spend on AI, but also how much free cash flow remains after such massive outlays. With rapid increases in data‑center, chip and cloud infrastructure spending, tech giants face a dual test of growth ambitions and financial discipline. Microsoft (MSFT-US) has offered a voluntary buyout to about 60,000 employees, Oracle (ORCL-US) is trimming headcount, and Meta Platforms (META-US) posted negative free cash flow, all highlighting the market’s heightened demand for capital efficiency.

Ludlow said on Bloomberg Radio that “Wall Street now cares about free cash flow, really cares.” He pointed out that cash‑rich firms such as Apple (AAPL-US) and NVIDIA (NVDA-US) have seen relatively strong recent stock performance, whereas Microsoft, Alphabet (GOOGL-US) and Meta have lagged. This gap shows the market is re‑evaluating each firm’s AI cost, cash‑flow resilience, and the timing of any return on investment.

Large tech firms are caught in a dilemma. On one hand, investors want companies to keep expanding AI initiatives to avoid falling behind competitors; on the other, building data centers, buying advanced chips and delivering cloud services require huge capital that continuously drains cash. As investment scales up and free cash flow shrinks, firms must find other cost‑saving measures or risk profit‑quality erosion, higher financing costs and waning shareholder confidence.

Microsoft recently offered a voluntary buyout to roughly 60,000 employees, about 27% of its global workforce, making it a flagship example of this cost‑control trend. The exact take‑up rate remains unknown. Reports suggest the offer may cover teams in Xbox, Windows, Copilot and finance, while some data‑center staff are excluded. Microsoft says the program is meant to help the organization align staffing with business needs, but it did not directly link the move to AI spending.

Microsoft’s cash‑flow pressure does not stem from stagnant operations. The company’s operating cash flow grew 34% in the last fiscal year, but infrastructure spending rose even faster, squeezing the cash available after capex. This reflects a core issue in the AI sector: even with rising revenue and operating cash flow, investors can still worry about cash‑flow quality if capital expenditures outpace growth.

Oracle provides another illustration. The firm has dramatically cut headcount this year to lower costs and free up money for AI data‑center expansion. TD Cowen estimates that trimming 20,000 to 30,000 jobs could add $8 billion to $10 billion of free cash‑flow capacity annually. Oracle’s stock was noticeably punished when it previously posted negative free cash flow, showing investors are becoming increasingly sensitive to capex and cash‑return timing.

Meta faces similar pressure. The company posted negative free cash flow last quarter, and its latest filing shows employee numbers are down 15% year‑over‑year. Yet Ludlow cautioned that market reactions differ across firms; even with similar financial metrics, stock prices can diverge based on how investors view growth prospects, investment strategy and execution ability. He described market response as volatile, noting investors do not simply buy or sell on the sign of free cash flow.

Cost pressures are also spilling into the financing market for AI data centers. Another Bloomberg report noted that at least 18 data‑center loans now carry double‑digit yields, indicating lenders and investors are becoming more cautious about AI infrastructure financing. As companies keep borrowing to build data centers, buy compute chips and purchase cloud capacity, higher funding costs could further compress future investment returns.

This does not mean AI demand has vanished, but capital markets now demand clearer financial proof. In the past, announcing larger AI spend could be seen as a proactive move; today, the market cares more about whether that spend translates into revenue growth, profit improvement and sustainable cash flow. Companies that chase scale without explaining payback periods or funding sources may face stricter valuation scrutiny.

Microsoft and Alphabet will release earnings after the U.S. market close on October 28, and investors will scrutinize the actual returns on their AI investments, especially cloud growth, capex and cash‑flow outlooks. For Microsoft, investors will look beyond Azure and AI service growth to see if infrastructure spending continues to outpace operating cash flow; Alphabet must demonstrate that AI spending can drive commercialization across search, cloud and other businesses.

Overall, Wall Street has not abandoned AI investment; it is shifting from asking “how much is being spent” to “how much can be earned back.” Microsoft’s buyouts, Oracle’s layoffs and Meta’s negative free cash flow reflect tech giants reshaping cost structures to fund costly AI infrastructure. Going forward, the market will focus more on whether firms can sustain growth while controlling capex, improving cash flow and proving the economic payoff of AI. For large tech companies, the AI race is no longer just about technology and compute power—it is increasingly a contest of cash‑flow management and capital allocation.

items.title: 輝達勁敵出招！攻入甲骨文雲端 傳OpenAI也將採購
items.title_en: NVIDIA's Rival Strikes: Moves Into Oracle Cloud, Reports Say OpenAI Also Plans to Buy
paras: 《巴隆週刊》週三 (28 日) 報導，Google 正加速推動自家人工智慧 (AI) 晶片商業化，除了將透過甲骨文 (ORCL-US) 雲端平台提供張量處理器 (TPU)，另傳 OpenAI 也計劃採購，讓輝達 (NVDA-US) 在 AI 晶片市場的主導地位面臨新一波挑戰。
隨著 AI 代理應用持續發展，投資人正評估輝達能否延續在 AI 運算市場的領先優勢。
Google 與博通 (AVGO-US) 合作設計的 TPU，被視為挑戰輝達的重要競爭產品。儘管 TPU 的成長並非新趨勢，Google 近期一連串動作顯示，該公司正更積極將這款晶片推向市場，爭取尋求輝達硬體替代方案的客戶。
Google 週二宣布，自 2027 年起，客戶將可透過甲骨文雲端基礎設施平台使用 TPU。這將是 Google 首度透過自家以外的超大規模雲端平台提供 TPU 服務，也代表其 AI 晶片的商業布局進一步向外延伸。
Google AI 與基礎設施資深副總裁 Amin Vahdat 表示，下一代 AI 將需要更多元的運算資源，而 TPU 能為客戶提供專為高需求模型訓練與推論工作打造的強大運算選項。
除了拓展供應管道，Google 也傳出取得大型客戶的進展。
科技媒體《The Information》週二晚間引述知情人士報導，ChatGPT 開發商 OpenAI 計劃採購 Google TPU。
不過，OpenAI 與 Google 均未立即回應置評請求。Google 母公司 Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 預定於週三美股盤後公布財報，AI 與雲端業務的發展將受到市場關注。
《巴隆週刊》指出，由於目前尚無採購金額或數量等細節，仍難以判斷 OpenAI 採用 TPU 是否會影響其與輝達之間的龐大業務往來，但這項消息再次凸顯，大型 AI 客戶仍積極尋求降低對輝達硬體的依賴，而 Google TPU 已成為其中最受青睞的替代選項。
輝達 (NVDA-US) 週二股價上漲 1.17%，報每股 215.38 美元，今年迄今漲幅14.05%。
paras_en: Baron Weekly reported on Wednesday (the 28th) that Google is accelerating the commercialization of its own artificial‑intelligence (AI) chips. In addition to offering Tensor Processing Units (TPUs) via Oracle’s (ORCL-US) cloud platform, it is said that OpenAI also plans to procure them, posing a fresh challenge to NVIDIA’s (NVDA-US) dominance in the AI‑chip market.
As AI‑agent applications continue to evolve, investors are assessing whether NVIDIA can maintain its leading edge in the AI computing market.

Google’s TPU, co‑designed with Broadcom (AVGO-US), is viewed as a major competitive threat to NVIDIA. Although TPU growth is not a new trend, a series of recent moves by Google indicate the company is pushing the chip more aggressively into the market to attract customers seeking alternatives to NVIDIA hardware.

Google announced on Tuesday that starting in 2027 customers will be able to use TPUs through Oracle’s cloud infrastructure platform. This will be Google’s first time offering TPU services on a hyperscale cloud platform that it does not own, further extending the commercial rollout of its AI chips beyond its own ecosystem.

Amin Vahdat, Google AI and Infrastructure Senior Vice President, said the next generation of AI will require more diverse compute resources, and TPUs provide a powerful option specifically built for training and inference of high‑demand models.
In addition to expanding its supply channels, Google is also reported to be making progress in securing large‑scale customers.
Technology outlet The Information cited insiders on Tuesday evening reporting that OpenAI, the developer of ChatGPT, plans to purchase Google TPUs.

Neither OpenAI nor Google responded immediately to requests for comment. Alphabet (GOOGL-US), Google’s parent company, is scheduled to release its earnings after the U.S. market close on Wednesday, and the development of its AI and cloud businesses will be closely watched by the market.

Baron Weekly noted that because no details on purchase amounts or quantities have been disclosed, it remains unclear whether OpenAI’s adoption of TPUs will affect its substantial business relationship with NVIDIA. Nonetheless, the news underscores that large AI customers are actively seeking to reduce reliance on NVIDIA hardware, with Google’s TPU emerging as the most favored alternative.
NVIDIA (NVDA-US) shares rose 1.17% on Tuesday, closing at $215.38 per share, up 14.05% year‑to‑date.

items.title: 蘋果首款觸控螢幕MacBook Pro登場！頂規售價飆14,549美元　OLED、動態島全上陣
items.title_en: Apple Unveils Its First Touchscreen MacBook Pro! Top Model Priced at $14,549, Featuring OLED and Dynamic Island
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US) 打破近20年來對觸控式Mac的堅持，推出首款搭載觸控螢幕的MacBook Pro，並首度將OLED顯示器與動態島導入Mac產品線，試圖透過高階功能提升旗艦筆電吸引力，進一步拉高產品平均售價。
新款MacBook Pro搭載M5 Pro及M5 Max晶片，提供14吋與16吋兩種規格，起售價分別為2,899美元（97,900台幣）及3,399美元（114,900台幣）。若選擇16TB儲存空間與128GB記憶體的頂規配置，售價更高達14,549美元。
不過，新品上市之際，全球個人電腦市場正面臨壓力。研究機構IDC數據顯示，全球PC第3季出貨量年減20%，蘋果同期出貨量也下滑，但跌幅小於整體市場。
分析指出，蘋果希望藉由觸控螢幕等高階功能吸引消費者，為Mac業務注入成長動能。蘋果股價周三（28日）收跌9.4%。
觸控螢幕MacBook Pro問世，也象徵蘋果正式改變長期以來對筆電觸控操作的立場。
蘋果共同創辦人賈伯斯（Steve Jobs）生前曾公開反對Mac採用觸控螢幕，認為這種設計在人體工學上並不理想。
前執行長庫克（Tim Cook）過去也曾以「把冰箱和烤麵包機合併」形容筆電與平板電腦融合的概念，對兩種產品形態合一持保留態度。
不過，根據《彭博》報導，約4年前，庫克與現任執行長特納斯（John Ternus）改變立場，開始推動MacBook Pro導入觸控螢幕。
新款MacBook Pro機身重量也有所降低。14吋機型從原本的3.5磅降至3磅，16吋機型則由4.7磅減至4磅。此外，機身背面的發光蘋果Logo也重新回歸。
蘋果硬體長Johny Srouji形容，新產品是Mac發展史上的一項里程碑。此次新品則由特納斯親自登台介紹。
此次MacBook Pro發布，是蘋果近期密集推出新品的一環。本周稍早，蘋果已推出搭載M6晶片的入門級14吋MacBook Pro、更新款iMac，以及配備OLED螢幕的新款iPad mini；上周五（23日），iPhone Duo也正式開賣。
這波新品更新為蘋果今年的產品發布周期增添重要一筆，也反映公司持續擴充產品陣容的策略。
然而，記憶體晶片價格上漲正推高整體電腦成本，進而對市場需求造成壓力。在PC產業面臨逆風之際，蘋果能否藉由觸控螢幕、OLED等高階規格吸引消費者，並帶動Mac銷售與平均售價成長，仍有待市場驗證。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) has broken its nearly 20-year stance against touchscreen Macs by launching the first MacBook Pro with a touch screen, and for the first time introducing OLED displays and the Dynamic Island to its Mac lineup, aiming to boost flagship laptop appeal with high‑end features and raise the average selling price of its products.

The new MacBook Pro comes with M5 Pro and M5 Max chips and is offered in 14‑inch and 16‑inch models, with starting prices of $2,899 (NT$97,900) and $3,399 (NT$114,900) respectively. The top‑spec configuration, featuring 16 TB of storage and 128 GB of memory, costs up to $14,549.

However, the launch comes as the global personal computer market faces pressure. IDC data shows global PC shipments fell 20% year‑over‑year in Q3, and Apple’s shipments also declined, though at a slower rate than the overall market.
Analysts say Apple hopes that high‑end features like a touchscreen will attract consumers and inject growth into its Mac business. Apple’s stock fell 9.4% on Wednesday (the 28th).
The arrival of a touchscreen MacBook Pro also signals Apple’s formal shift away from its long‑standing opposition to touch input on laptops.
Co‑founder Steve Jobs had publicly opposed adding a touchscreen to Macs, arguing that such a design was not ergonomically ideal.
Former CEO Tim Cook previously likened the convergence of laptops and tablets to “combining a refrigerator and a toaster,” expressing reservations about merging the two product forms.
However, Bloomberg reports that about four years ago Cook and current CEO John Ternus changed their stance and began pushing for a touchscreen MacBook Pro.

The new MacBook Pro’s chassis is also lighter: the 14‑inch model drops from 3.5 lb to 3 lb, and the 16‑inch model from 4.7 lb to 4 lb. In addition, the illuminated Apple logo on the back of the device returns.
Hardware chief Johny Srouji described the product as a milestone in Mac history, and the new model was introduced on stage by Ternus himself.

The MacBook Pro announcement is part of Apple’s recent flurry of new releases. Earlier this week Apple launched an entry‑level 14‑inch MacBook Pro with the M6 chip, an updated iMac, and a new iPad mini with an OLED screen; last Friday (the 23rd) the iPhone Duo also went on sale.
This wave of new products adds a significant chapter to Apple’s 2024 release cycle and reflects the company’s ongoing strategy to expand its product portfolio.

However, rising memory‑chip prices are pushing up overall computer costs, putting pressure on market demand. As the PC industry faces headwinds, it remains to be seen whether Apple can attract consumers with high‑end specs like touchscreens and OLED and drive Mac sales and average selling price growth.

items.title: AI搶錢大戰白熱化！全球債券發行量破紀錄 科技巨頭成借貸主力
items.title_en: AI Funding Battle Heats Up! Global Bond Issuance Hits Record, Tech Giants Lead Lending
paras: 全球債券市場正經歷一場由AI驅動的歷史性擴張。科技巨頭為搶占AI基礎設施建設先機而掀起的借貸狂潮，正在從根本上重塑全球資本市場的競爭格局。
《彭博社》週四（29日）報導，彙整數據顯示，金融機構、企業和政府今年迄今透過投資級和垃圾級債券合計融資6.61兆美元，年增15%，在距年底尚餘兩個月之際，已打破2025年的歷史紀錄。其中，雲端運算巨頭和資料中心開發商單獨發行的債務規模接近3,680億美元，是去年同期的六倍以上，約占今年整體借貸增量的三分之一，超越所有其他非金融行業，新增債務規模更是政府部門的兩倍。
此趨勢正在深刻改變全球債務市場的競爭生態。亞馬遜今年已躋身全球最大債券發行人第四位，僅次於德國、歐盟和義大利，超越法國和英國；美國十大企業發行人中，科技公司占據五席，金融機構的占比則降至至少十年來的最低水準。同時，全球殖利率上升、各國政府赤字擴大，資本爭奪戰日趨激烈，市場承壓跡象已現。
摩根大通投資級融資全球主管John Servidea表示，「在一年之內，我們見證了全球最大市場頂端的根本性重排。圍繞AI出現了一個新的長期主題。」
彭博追蹤的一批超大規模雲端運算商（hyperscaler）及新興雲端服務商（neocloud），預計未來三年將投入近4.5兆美元用於AI基礎設施建設，支出規模前所未見。
在美國市場，亞馬遜已成為最大的企業借款人，其次是Alphabet。科技公司對債券市場的主導地位，標誌著金融機構長期占據企業發行榜首的格局正在被打破，後者的市場占比已跌至至少十年來的最低點。
供給消化壓力：投資人要求更高補償
大規模發債並非一帆風順，市場已出現明顯的消化壓力。
投資人起初爭相搶購AI基礎設施相關債券，但隨著大型發行案接連湧現，對過度支出的擔憂，以及AI獲利兌現時間表的不確定性逐漸升高，部分投資人開始退場觀望，並要求更高的殖利率補償。在美國，資料中心開發商為融資專案發行的投資級債券，殖利率已高達7.2%。
CoreWeave是一家為Meta等科技巨頭提供運算能力的投機級企業。由於市場擔憂其債務負擔持續攀升，該公司債券本月稍早遭到大幅拋售，信用風險急遽升高，並在整個信貸市場引發連鎖反應。即使是Meta Platforms和Oracle等大型藍籌雲端運算業者，其違約保護成本也已大幅飆升。
整體信用環境同樣趨於惡化。高油價、中東地緣政治緊張局勢升級，以及法國主權債券遭拋售，共同壓抑市場情緒。部分美國公債殖利率近期攀升至2002年以來的最高水準，推高企業融資與再融資成本。
AI投資熱潮引發的資本需求激增，已開始引起全球央行關注。
國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）總裁Kristalina Georgieva本月呼籲各國央行保持「審慎的鷹派立場」，以因應持續的通膨壓力。全球主要央行預計將以更緊縮的貨幣政策立場進入2027年。
花旗新興市場經濟學主管Johanna Chua上週在花旗播客節目中表示：「央行正在意識到，AI週期中的資本需求確實出現了某種程度的躍升，這正在對R-star（中性利率）形成上行壓力。」所謂R-star，是指既不刺激也不抑制經濟成長的「中性」利率水準。這意味著AI驅動的資本需求，可能從結構上推升全球長期利率中樞。
11月或迎新一輪發行高峰
儘管短期承壓，市場對AI資本支出的長期前景仍持樂觀態度，11月有望迎來新一輪發行高潮。
RBC Global Asset Management投資組合經理Neil Sun表示，儘管超大規模雲端運算商的融資壓力造成了一些短期「供給消化問題」，但AI資本支出的前景依然強勁，為持續大規模借貸奠定了基礎。Sun在採訪中表示：「從基本面來看，它們的營運狀況良好。」他並補充，運算能力需求「依然非常強勁」。他預計AI投資將延續至2027年，儘管利率環境有所升高。
摩根士丹利歐洲、中東及非洲投資級銀團主管Matteo Benedetto表示：「11月實際上是全年企業發行最繁忙的月份之一。對於正在推進併購或資本支出、無法等待時機的企業而言，這仍是一個預先融資的窗口期。」大摩預計，在經歷過去兩個月的波動之後，11月將迎來密集的借貸活動。
paras_en: The global bond market is undergoing a historic AI‑driven expansion. A borrowing frenzy sparked by tech giants racing to secure AI infrastructure is fundamentally reshaping the competitive landscape of world capital markets.

Bloomberg reported on Thursday (the 29th) that data show financial institutions, corporations and governments have raised a total of $6.61 trillion this year through investment‑grade and high‑yield bonds, a 15% year‑over‑year increase, breaking the 2025 record with two months left in the year. Cloud‑computing giants and data‑center developers alone issued debt close to $368 billion—more than six times the amount a year ago—accounting for roughly one‑third of this year’s total borrowing increase, outpacing all other non‑financial sectors and twice the size of new debt issued by governments.

This trend is profoundly altering the competitive ecology of the global debt market. Amazon has risen to the fourth‑largest bond issuer worldwide this year, behind Germany, the EU and Italy and ahead of France and the UK. Among the top ten U.S. corporate issuers, tech firms hold five slots while financial institutions have fallen to their lowest share in at least a decade. At the same time, rising global yields and widening sovereign deficits are intensifying capital battles, and market stress is already visible.

John Servidea, JPMorgan’s global head of investment‑grade financing, said, “In just one year we have witnessed a fundamental reshuffling at the top of the world’s largest market. A new long‑term theme has emerged around AI.”

Bloomberg’s tracking of a group of ultra‑large hyperscalers and emerging “neocloud” providers estimates they will spend nearly $4.5 trillion over the next three years on AI infrastructure, an unprecedented level of outlay.

In the United States, Amazon is now the biggest corporate borrower, followed by Alphabet. The dominance of tech firms in the bond market signals the erosion of the long‑standing pattern of financial institutions topping corporate issuance, with their market share now at a decade‑low.
Supply‑digestion pressure: investors demand higher compensation
Large‑scale issuance has not been smooth; the market is already showing clear digestion pressure.

Investors initially scrambled for AI‑infrastructure‑related bonds, but as a wave of big issuances arrived, concerns over overspending and the uncertain timing of AI profit realization grew. Some investors have stepped back, demanding higher yields. In the U.S., investment‑grade bonds issued by data‑center developers to fund projects are yielding as much as 7.2%.

CoreWeave, a speculative‑grade firm that provides compute power to tech giants such as Meta, saw its bonds sold off sharply earlier this month amid worries that its debt load is climbing, sharply raising its credit risk and triggering a chain reaction across the credit market. Even blue‑chip cloud players like Meta Platforms and Oracle have seen their default‑protection costs surge.

The overall credit environment is also deteriorating. High oil prices, escalating Middle‑East geopolitical tensions and a sell‑off in French sovereign bonds are dampening market sentiment. Some U.S. Treasury yields have recently risen to their highest levels since 2002, pushing up corporate financing and refinancing costs.
The surge in capital demand driven by the AI investment boom has begun to attract the attention of central banks worldwide.

IMF Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva this month urged central banks to maintain a “cautiously hawkish stance” to cope with persistent inflation pressures. Major central banks are expected to adopt tighter monetary policies through 2027.

Citigroup’s emerging‑markets chief economist Johanna Chua said on a Citi podcast last week, “Central banks are realizing that capital demand in the AI cycle has indeed jumped to some extent, putting upward pressure on the neutral rate (R*).” R* refers to the “neutral” interest‑rate level that neither stimulates nor restrains economic growth, implying that AI‑driven capital needs could structurally lift the global long‑term rate anchor.
November may usher in a new issuance peak
Despite short‑term pressure, the market remains optimistic about the long‑term outlook for AI‑driven capital spending, with a fresh wave of issuances expected in November.

Neil Sun, portfolio manager at RBC Global Asset Management, said that although financing pressure from ultra‑large cloud providers has caused some short‑term “supply‑digestion issues,” the outlook for AI capital spending remains strong and underpins continued large‑scale borrowing. Sun told interviewers, “Fundamentally, their operating conditions are sound,” adding that demand for compute power “remains very strong.” He expects AI investment to continue through 2027 despite a higher‑rate environment.

Matteo Benedetto, head of investment‑grade syndicates for Europe, the Middle East and Africa at Morgan Stanley, said, “November is actually one of the busiest months of the year for corporate issuance. For companies pushing ahead with M&A or capex that can’t wait for a better window, it remains a pre‑financing opportunity.” Morgan Stanley expects a dense bout of borrowing activity in November after the volatility of the past two months.

items.title: 現代汽車獲利優預期，為何仍下修展望、縮減投資？
items.title_en: Hyundai Motor Beats Profit Forecast Yet Cuts Outlook and Investment Plans
paras: 2026年10月29日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 現代汽車Hyundai Motor(005380-KR)第三季營業利益年增5.5%，優於市場預期，但同步下修全年營業利益率、銷量及資本支出目標。匯率有利雖支撐單季獲利，部分罷工、既有車款老化及市場競爭加劇，仍對營運形成壓力。
現代汽車第三季營業利益達2.7兆韓元（約20.1億美元），高於市場預估的2.4兆韓元；營收則年減3.4%至45.1兆韓元。公司表示，有利匯率抵銷了部分罷工與老舊車款銷售疲弱的影響。
公司將2026年營業利益率目標由6.3%至7.3%，下修至5.5%至6.5%；全年汽車銷量目標由416萬輛降至400萬輛，資本支出也由17.8兆韓元縮減至16兆韓元，降幅約一成。
此次調整距離公司7月維持全年展望僅三個月。當時現代汽車預期，供應商火災造成的生產干擾過後，可透過提高產量與推出新車，帶動下半年成長，如今則轉為下修年度目標。

由於中國電動車業者加快布局南韓與歐洲，加上現代汽車平價電動車款選擇有限，增加銷售壓力。以南韓為例，比亞迪BYD(002594-CN)於2025年1月進入乘用車市場、同年4月開始交車，首年銷量6,107輛，2026年前九月掛牌量已達20,137輛，約為去年全年的3.3倍，躍居當地第四大進口乘用車品牌，僅次於特斯拉Tesla(TSLA-US)、寶馬BMW(BMW-DE)與賓士Mercedes-Benz(MBG-DE)。
除了銷售競爭加劇，成本上升也壓縮車廠獲利空間。
根據優分析先前報導，通用汽車General Motors(GM-US)已因為原物料與物流成本在短短8至10週內明顯攀升，下修了財測區間，若漲勢持續，將增加2027年獲利成長的難度；賓士也下修今年轎車事業獲利目標，成本變化成為本輪財報季的重要觀察焦點。
亞洲供應鏈早在8月便提出警訊。日產汽車Nissan(7201-JP)面臨運費增加，本田Honda(7267-JP)預期下半年原物料成本壓力加重；電池供應商傑士湯淺GS Yuasa(6674-JP)則表示，即使調漲售價，仍無法完全轉嫁材料成本漲幅。

paras_en: 2026-10-29 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center) – Hyundai Motor (005380-KR) posted a 5.5% year‑over‑year increase in third‑quarter operating profit, beating market expectations, but simultaneously lowered its full‑year operating profit margin, sales and capital‑expenditure targets. A favorable exchange rate helped support quarterly profit, yet partial strikes, aging model lines and intensified competition continue to pressure operations.

Hyundai’s third‑quarter operating profit reached 2.7 trillion won (about $2.01 billion), above the market estimate of 2.4 trillion won; revenue fell 3.4% year‑on‑year to 45.1 trillion won. The company said the favorable exchange rate offset some of the impact from strikes and weak sales of older models.

The firm cut its 2026 operating‑profit‑margin target from 6.3‑7.3% to 5.5‑6.5%; the annual vehicle‑sales target was reduced from 4.16 million units to 4.00 million units, and capital spending was trimmed from 17.8 trillion won to 16 trillion won, roughly a 10% cut.

This adjustment comes just three months after Hyundai maintained its full‑year outlook in July. At that time the company expected that, after production disruptions caused by a supplier fire, higher output and new‑model launches would drive second‑half growth; it now revises its annual targets downward.

Chinese EV makers are accelerating their presence in South Korea and Europe, and Hyundai’s limited low‑price EV lineup is adding sales pressure. In South Korea, BYD (002594-CN) entered the passenger‑car market in January 2025, began deliveries in April, sold 6,107 units in its first year, and by September 2026 had registered 20,137 units – about 3.3 times last year’s total – becoming the fourth‑largest imported passenger‑car brand locally, behind Tesla (TSLA‑US), BMW (BMW‑DE) and Mercedes‑Benz (MBG‑DE).
In addition to tougher sales competition, rising costs are squeezing automakers’ profit margins.

According to earlier U‑Analysis reporting, General Motors (GM‑US) has already lowered its earnings guidance after raw‑material and logistics costs surged sharply over just 8‑10 weeks; if the price climb continues, it will make 2027 profit growth harder. Mercedes‑Benz also cut its sedan‑division profit target this year, making cost changes a key focus of this earnings season.

Asian supply chains raised alarms as early as August. Nissan (7201‑JP) faces higher freight costs, Honda (7267‑JP) expects increased raw‑material cost pressure in the second half, and battery supplier GS Yuasa (6674‑JP) says that even with price hikes it cannot fully pass on material‑cost increases.
