items.title: 《大賣空》原型人物點破Anthropic招股書暗藏數字：隱形算力承諾5370億美元
items.title_en: The Real‑Life Figure Behind “The Big Short” Exposes Hidden Numbers in Anthropic’s Prospectus: Invisible Compute Commitment of $537 billion
paras: 「這份S-1裡最該上頭條的數字，從來沒有以單一金額出現過。」《大賣空》原型人物貝瑞(Michael Burry)在最新Substack文章中如此說道，他並將Anthropic招股書附註裡散落的算力合約逐一加總，算出約5370億美元的計算與基礎設施承諾，並直言這才是這家公司真正的財務重心。
這位傳奇投資人拆解的明細包括：谷歌1145億、亞馬遜1100億、微軟449億美元採購承諾；博通1612億美元TPU機櫃租賃；新創雲廠商Lambda與Nscale合計約860億；超微預計超200億。若計入尚在敲定的谷歌TPU追加協議(1250億至1500億)與SpaceX最高1205億美元合作，總承諾可逼近8000億美元，超過過去一年營收的20倍。
Anthropic週一(26日)公開遞交S-1，擬以代號「ANT」在那斯達克全球精選市場上市，由高盛與摩根士丹利主承銷，發行股數與價格區間尚未公布。
貝瑞指出，營收成長正與龐大承諾同步堆高：2026年前兩季環比增速曾達132%、144%，第三季降至約45%，單季營收近169億美元；8、9月月增率只剩3%至7%，每1美元算力產出的營收也從2.08美元滑落到1.70美元，是該指標首次轉弱。
更關鍵的是合約性質，多數協議屬「take-or-pay(照付不議)」，也就是無論實際用量多少，Anthropic都須按期付款並補足差額。
貝瑞還點出資金循環：亞馬遜、谷歌共向Anthropic出資約410億美元，這筆錢很大一部分又透過算力採購流回雲廠商；超大规模業者同時掌握「出資方、供應商、銷售渠道、股東」四重身分，並經雲市場收取Anthropic約48%的營收。
投資人Nicholas Mugalli認為，約5000億美元算力已鎖進各大晶片廠，代表AI基建才剛起步。
《Benzinga》報導也提醒，807億美元淨虧損多數來自可轉換票據的非現金會計費用，營業虧損實為6.93億美元。
貝瑞也預期Anthropic路演前S-1會再修訂，補入Q3細節與10月營收運行率，「結果其實已經清楚了」。
paras_en: Michael Burry, the real‑life inspiration for “The Big Short,” wrote in a recent Substack post that the most headline‑worthy figure in the S‑1 has never appeared as a single amount. He added up the scattered compute contracts in Anthropic’s filing and calculated roughly $537 billion in computing and infrastructure commitments, saying that this is the company’s true financial focus.

The breakdown he detailed includes procurement commitments of $114.5 billion from Google, $110 billion from Amazon and $44.9 billion from Microsoft; Broadcom’s $161.2 billion TPU rack leasing; startup cloud providers Lambda and Nscale combined at about $86 billion; and AMD’s expected commitment of over $20 billion. If the still‑pending Google TPU add‑on agreement ($125‑$150 billion) and a maximum $120.5 billion partnership with SpaceX are added, total commitments approach $800 billion, more than 20 times last year’s revenue.

Anthropic filed its S‑1 on Monday (the 26th), planning to list under the ticker “ANT” on the Nasdaq Global Select Market, with Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley as lead underwriters. The number of shares and price range have not yet been disclosed.

Burry points out that revenue growth is climbing in step with the massive commitments: year‑over‑year growth in the first two quarters of 2026 hit 132% and 144%, then fell to about 45% in the third quarter, with quarterly revenue near $16.9 billion; August‑September month‑over‑month growth slipped to just 3%‑7%, and revenue per $1 of compute dropped from $2.08 to $1.70, marking the first weakening of that metric.
More crucial is the nature of the contracts—most are “take‑or‑pay,” meaning Anthropic must make scheduled payments and cover any shortfall regardless of actual usage.

Burry also highlights the capital flow: Amazon and Google together have invested about $41 billion in Anthropic, a large portion of which cycles back to cloud vendors through compute purchases. These hyperscale players simultaneously occupy four roles—investor, supplier, sales channel and shareholder—and collect roughly 48% of Anthropic’s revenue via the cloud market.
Investor Nicholas Mugalli believes roughly $500 billion of compute capacity is already locked into major chip makers, indicating that AI infrastructure is only just getting started.
Benzinga reports that the $80.7 billion net loss is largely due to non‑cash accounting charges on convertible notes, with the actual operating loss standing at $693 million.
Burry also expects Anthropic’s S‑1 to be revised before the roadshow to incorporate Q3 details and the October revenue run‑rate, saying “the result is actually already clear.”

items.title: 「股神」也失手？巴菲特最後一筆重大投資恐遇挫、Alphabet持股市值蒸發70億美元
items.title_en: Even the 'Oracle of Omaha' Makes a Mistake? Buffett’s Last Major Investment Faces Setback, Alphabet Shares Lose $7 Billion in Market Value
paras: 股神巴菲特（Warren Buffett）卸任波克夏(BRK.A-US) 董事長前的最後一筆重大股票投資，目前面臨考驗。Google(GOOGL-US) 母公司 Alphabet 第三季財報表現不如市場預期，股價盤後大幅下挫，使波克夏先前大舉買進的持股價值縮水。
根據《巴隆周刊》報導，波克夏在2026年上半年持續加碼 Alphabet，其中包括6月初參與該公司規模850億美元的股票增資，以每股約350美元買進價值100億美元的股票。
Alphabet公佈的第三季每股收益為2.12美元，低於去年同期的2.87美元，也低於市場普遍預期的約3美元。受此影響，Alphabet 有表決權股票在盤後交易中下跌11%，報每股288美元。
此外，由於大舉投入人工智慧（AI）相關資本支出，Alphabet 的自由現金流為負90億美元。
巴菲特7月接受《CNBC》訪問時曾表示，買進 Alphabet 股票是他本人的決定。巴菲特已於2025年底卸下波克夏執行長職務，但當時仍保留董事長職位，近期則已將董事長職務交給兒子霍華・巴菲特（Howard Buffett）。
報導指出，波克夏持有 Alphabet 股票的平均成本無法確定，但很可能高於每股300美元，甚至可能接近每股320美元。
波克夏於2025年第三季買進1,800萬股 Alphabet 股票，當時股價平均約225美元；2026年第一季再買進約4,000萬股，平均股價約315美元；第二季則買進近5,000萬股，其中近3,000萬股來自每股約350美元的承銷發行。
截至6月30日，波克夏共持有1.06億股 Alphabet 股票，包括有表決權及無表決權股份。
以盤後股價計算，波克夏持有的 Alphabet 股權目前價值約300億美元，低於6月高峰時的370億美元。Alphabet 是波克夏第四大股票持倉，排名僅次於蘋果(AAPL-US) 、美國運通(AXP-US) 及可口可樂(KO-US) 。
《巴隆》6月曾指出，考慮到 Alphabet 股價在前一年已大幅上漲，波克夏進場時機可能偏晚。
波克夏過去曾公布旗下前15大股票持倉及其成本基礎，但在2020年代初期停止這麼做。這使外界更難計算波克夏許多新近投資的獲利或虧損，也讓市場難以追究管理層在股票投資方面的決策責任。
報導指出，執行長阿貝爾（Greg Abel）應考慮在2027年發布的下一封年度股東信中，恢復公布股票持倉及成本基礎的表格。
paras_en: The last major stock purchase made by Warren Buffett before stepping down as chairman of Berkshire Hathaway (BRK.A-US) is now under scrutiny. Alphabet’s (GOOGL-US) third‑quarter earnings fell short of market expectations, causing its stock to drop sharply in after‑hours trading and eroding the value of Berkshire’s sizeable holdings.

According to Barron's, Berkshire continued to add to its Alphabet stake in the first half of 2026, including a June‑early participation in the company’s $85 billion equity offering, buying $10 billion of shares at roughly $350 per share.

Alphabet reported a Q3 earnings per share of $2.12, lower than last year’s $2.87 and below the market’s roughly $3 expectation. As a result, Alphabet’s voting shares fell 11% in after‑hours trading, trading at $288 per share.
In addition, Alphabet’s free cash flow turned negative $9 billion due to large capital expenditures on artificial‑intelligence (AI) initiatives.

During a CNBC interview in July, Buffett said buying Alphabet stock was his personal decision. He stepped down as Berkshire’s CEO at the end of 2025 but remained chairman until recently, when he handed the role to his son Howard Buffett.
Reports indicate Berkshire’s average cost basis for Alphabet shares is unclear but likely above $300 per share, possibly approaching $320 per share.

Berkshire bought 18 million Alphabet shares in Q3 2025 at an average price of about $225 per share; in Q1 2026 it purchased roughly 40 million shares at an average of $315 per share; in Q2 it bought nearly 50 million shares, of which about 30 million came from an underwritten offering at roughly $350 per share.
As of June 30, Berkshire owned a total of 106 million Alphabet shares, including both voting and non‑voting shares.

Using the after‑hours price, Berkshire’s Alphabet holdings are currently worth about $30 billion, down from a peak of $37 billion in June. Alphabet is Berkshire’s fourth‑largest holding, behind Apple (AAPL‑US), American Express (AXP‑US) and Coca‑Cola (KO‑US).
Barron's noted in June that, given Alphabet’s sharp price rise the previous year, Berkshire’s entry timing may have been late.

Berkshire previously disclosed its top 15 holdings and cost basis, but stopped doing so in the early 2020s. This makes it harder for outsiders to calculate the gains or losses on many recent investments and hampers accountability for management’s investment decisions.
The report suggests CEO Greg Abel should consider reinstating the disclosure of share holdings and cost basis in the 2027 annual letter to shareholders.

items.title: 陸國產GPU實測硬撼輝達H200！天數智芯天垓300跨過「高質量算力」門檻
items.title_en: China's Domestic GPU Rivals Nvidia H200 in Real-World Tests! TianShu ZhiXin TianGai 300 Crosses the “High‑Quality Compute” Threshold
paras: 中國國產通用GPU邁入新階段，天數智芯周三(28日)在上海舉辦「從模型到世界」媒體開放日，首度實機展示天垓300通用GPU，並公佈上海儀電第三方測試結果：在典型PD分離部署下，天垓300折算單卡端到端吞吐達到輝達H200的1.05倍，成為中國首個實測性能逼近國際旗艦水準的通用GPU。

這次第三方測試涵蓋四大主流模型、三類場景：64K長上下文下Attention性能為H200的1.05倍；GLM-5.3模型MoE吞吐達H200的1.15倍；Agent首字延遲較H200降低10%至30%；多模態生成推理吞吐提升2%至5%；搜廣推在線業務推薦推理吞吐提升21%、輕量計算時延降低26%。訓練端同樣有突破。基於Qwen3-32B的8卡FP8訓練演示中，單卡有效吞吐達H100的1.33倍。
天數智芯說，「對標H200，是因為它代表當前大模型推理與複雜計算的高水位」，並稱這一階段的競爭標準概括為高效率、可預期、可持續的「高質量算力」。天垓300在長時間滿負載下步時波動僅0.43%，低於對比Hopper方案的0.76%，意味著Token工廠這類規模化場景能真正「跑得穩、算得出價值」。
系統層面，天垓300 IXL144超節點在單一標準機櫃內集成144顆GPU、聚合约10.1TB顯存，是目前業界密度最高的單機櫃GPU超節點。根據測算，天垓300每百萬有效Token成本較國際主流方案可降低約40%。新世代P2P互聯引擎目標將域內單次傳輸延遲由3至5微秒壓至1微秒，並支持統一內存語義與大EP專家並行。
更關鍵的是開放異構路線。天垓300支持AFD分離部署：自身承擔Prefill全流程與解碼階段Attention，合作廠商XPU承擔FFN專家網絡，統一調度下解碼推理延遲實測降低60%，為中國首個跑通的「GPU+XPU」異構AFD方案。
天數智芯AI與加速計算負責人單天逸表示，未來AI算力系統不會由一種晶片包打天下，重點是把不同晶片高效組織起來。
軟體棧則指向「用AI開發AI」。天數智算首次系統性擁抱Agentic AI：環境部署從1小時縮至10分鐘、人工操作由數十步減至1步；某大模型調優任務週期由7天壓到2小時內，性能接近翻倍；深度接入FlyDSL後，過去10人每天的工作可讓1人在小時級完成，編譯速度提升90%以上。工程師經驗被沉澱為可調用工具，讓一位專家的優化能力服務千萬開發者。

端側產品同步下沉。彤央TY1200標稱300 TOPS稠密算力(非稀疏峰值)，在Qwen3.8-27B、Qwen3.6-35B-A3B等模型實測達到輝達Thor T5000的1.2倍；物理AI場景下，基於MuJoCo-Warp的本地GPU仿真讓機器人「本地仿真—策略訓練—動作驗證」循環跑通，Cosmos-R2-2B/8B性能分別達T5000的158%與180%。TY1200已用於陪診機器人、工業視覺、文旅導覽等現場，下一代TY2000標稱算力將達600T。
從雲端天垓300、智算軟體棧到端側彤央終端，天數智芯試圖打通「雲—邊—端」增強回路。在中國全面推進「AI+」與新質生产力建設的背景下，國產GPU的敘事正在改寫：不再只回答「能不能用」，而是回答「每單位投入能穩定產出多少有效Token」。這道門檻，天垓300已經實測邁過。
paras_en: China’s domestically‑produced general‑purpose GPU has entered a new stage. On Wednesday (the 28th) TianShu ZhiXin held a media open day in Shanghai titled “From Model to World”, debuting the TianGai 300 general‑purpose GPU and releasing third‑party test results from Shanghai Yidian. In a typical PD‑separated deployment, the TianGai 300’s per‑card end‑to‑end throughput reaches 1.05 times that of Nvidia’s H200, making it the first Chinese GPU whose measured performance approaches the level of an international flagship.

The third‑party test covered four mainstream models across three scenario types: under a 64K long‑context, attention performance is 1.05 times H200; the GLM‑5.3 MoE model’s throughput reaches 1.15 times H200; agent first‑token latency is reduced by 10‑30 % compared with H200; multimodal generation inference throughput improves by 2‑5 %; and search‑wide recommendation inference throughput rises by 21 % with lightweight compute latency cut by 26 %. Training also saw breakthroughs: in an 8‑card FP8 training demo based on Qwen‑3‑32B, a single card’s effective throughput is 1.33 times that of an H100.

TianShu ZhiXin said the benchmark against H200 is because it represents the current high water‑mark for large‑model inference and complex computation, and defined the competition standard at this stage as high‑efficiency, predictable, and sustainable “high‑quality compute”. The TianGai 300’s performance under sustained full‑load varies by only 0.43 %, lower than the 0.76 % of the comparative Hopper solution, meaning that large‑scale token‑factory scenarios can truly “run stably and deliver value”.

At the system level, the TianGai 300 IXL144 super‑node integrates 144 GPUs and about 10.1 TB of video memory within a single standard rack, the highest‑density single‑rack GPU super‑node in the industry. Calculations show the TianGai 300 can lower the cost per million effective tokens by roughly 40 % compared with mainstream international solutions. Its next‑generation P2P interconnect engine aims to compress intra‑domain single‑transfer latency from 3‑5 µs to 1 µs, while supporting unified memory semantics and parallel large‑expert (EP) processing.

More crucially, the architecture is open and heterogeneous. The TianGai 300 supports AFD‑separated deployment: it handles the full prefill flow and the attention stage of decoding, while a partner‑supplied XPU handles the FFN expert network. Under unified scheduling, decoding inference latency was measured to drop by 60 %, making it China’s first operational “GPU+XPU” heterogeneous AFD solution.

TianShu ZhiXin’s head of AI and accelerated computing, Dan Tianyi, said future AI compute systems will not be dominated by a single chip; the key is to efficiently orchestrate different chips together.

The software stack points to “using AI to develop AI”. TianShu’s AI computing platform first systematically embraces Agentic AI: environment deployment time shrank from 1 hour to 10 minutes, manual steps dropped from dozens to one; a large‑model tuning task cycle was compressed from 7 days to under 2 hours, nearly doubling performance; after deep integration of FlyDSL, work that previously required ten people daily can now be completed by one person in hours, with compilation speed up over 90 %. Engineer expertise is distilled into callable tools, allowing one expert’s optimization ability to serve millions of developers.

Edge products are being rolled out in parallel. The TongYang TY1200, rated at 300 TOPS dense compute (non‑sparse peak), achieved 1.2 times the performance of Nvidia’s Thor T5000 in real‑world tests on models such as Qwen‑3.8‑27B and Qwen‑3.6‑35B‑A3B. In physical AI scenarios, local GPU simulation based on MuJoCo‑Warp enabled a “local simulation → policy training → action verification” loop for robots, with Cosmos‑R2‑2B and Cosmos‑R2‑8B reaching 158 % and 180 % of the T5000’s performance respectively. The TY1200 is already used in companion‑care robots, industrial vision, and cultural‑tourism guides; the next‑generation TY2000 is slated to deliver 600 TOPS.

From the cloud‑based TianGai 300 and AI computing software stack to the edge‑side TongYang terminals, TianShu ZhiXin aims to close the “cloud‑edge‑device” reinforcement loop. Against the backdrop of China’s comprehensive push for “AI+” and new‑quality productivity, the narrative around domestic GPUs is being rewritten: no longer just answering “can it be used?”, but answering “how many effective tokens can be stably produced per unit of investment”. By this metric, the TianGai 300 has already passed the threshold in real‑world tests.

items.title: 日劇《VIVANT》惹怒中國 Hello Kitty品牌方深夜致歉
items.title_en: Japanese Drama “VIVANT” Angers China, Hello Kitty Brand Apologizes Late at Night
paras: 日本熱門日劇《VIVANT》因劇情涉及中國組織與暴力情節，遭中國鷹派喉舌《環球時報》批評抹黑中國，並點名日本三麗鷗，三麗鷗28日（周三）深夜宣布終止聯名合作。
擁有Hello Kitty、玉桂狗、美樂蒂等知名IP的三麗鷗，28日深夜在三麗鷗官方微博發布聲明，宣布終止VIVANT與三麗鷗角色聯動合作。
據《財聯社》29日報導，三麗鷗表示，近日收到關於《VIVANT》聯名商品的意見，給大家帶來擔憂，三麗鷗深表歉意。
三麗鷗寫道，關於本次聯名相關內容，包含與三麗鷗集團企業理念不符的表達，因此決定停止本次聯名及所有後續項目及宣傳活動。
目前三麗鷗正積極展開相應處理工作，今後在展開聯名合作項目時將進一步加強審核機制。
日本TBS電視台推出的熱門日劇《VIVANT》劇情屢屢反轉，深受觀眾喜愛，近期卻因劇情涉及中國相關組織的情節，遭《環球時報》批評抹黑中國，甚至點名三麗鷗，呼籲品牌與作品劃清界線。
TBS社長龍寶正峰28日在記者會上首度回應爭議，強調《VIVANT》是完全虛構娛樂作品，無意煽動國家對立或傷害特定國家民眾。
paras_en: Japanese popular drama VIVANT was criticized by China’s hawkish mouthpiece Global Times for plot elements involving Chinese organisations and violence, accusing it of smearing China and specifically naming Sanrio; Sanrio announced late at night on the 28th (Wednesday) that it would terminate the co‑branding partnership.

Sanrio, the owner of well‑known IPs such as Hello Kitty, Cinnamoroll and My Melody, posted a statement on its official Weibo late on the 28th, announcing the termination of the VIVANT‑Sanrio character collaboration.
According to Caixin’s report on the 29th, Sanrio said it had recently received feedback about the VIVANT co‑branded merchandise that caused concern, and Sanrio expressed deep apologies to the public.

Sanrio wrote that the content related to this collaboration includes expressions that are inconsistent with Sanrio Group’s corporate philosophy, and therefore it decided to halt the collaboration as well as all subsequent projects and promotional activities.
Sanrio is currently actively handling the matter and will further strengthen its review mechanisms for any future co‑branding projects.

The popular drama VIVANT, launched by Japan’s TBS television network, is known for frequent plot twists and has been well liked by viewers, but recently its storyline involving Chinese‑related organisations drew criticism from Global Times, which accused it of smearing China and even singled out Sanrio, calling for the brand to distance itself from the show.

TBS President Ryū Hōshō responded to the controversy at a press conference on the 28th, emphasizing that VIVANT is a completely fictional entertainment work with no intention to incite national antagonism or harm any country’s people.

items.title: 財測釋利多｜甲骨文（ORCL）AI燒錢何時回收？現金流轉正時程曝光，股價大漲11%
items.title_en: Financial Forecast Highlights Benefits: When Will Oracle (ORCL) AI Cash Burn Turn Positive? Cash Flow Recovery Timeline Revealed, Stock Jumps 11%
paras: 2026年10月29日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ AI資料中心持續擴建，投資人最想知道的，已不只是科技公司能接到多少訂單，而是投入的資金何時能夠回收。
甲骨文Oracle(ORCL-US)美國時間10月28日更新中長期財測，預計自由現金流於2028會計年度下半年轉正，2029會計年度達至少300億美元，並為後續額外籌資設定上限。消息緩解市場對AI投資資金需求的疑慮，帶動當日股價收盤大漲約11%。
(圖片來源:優分析產業資料庫)

資本支出高峰在前，現金回收目標在後
甲骨文表示，2027與2028會計年度將處於資本支出高峰，2029會計年度起支出預計下降。公司目標是在2028會計年度下半年實現正自由現金流，並於2029會計年度開始，以自身產生的資金支應成長。
自由現金流，可以理解為營運產生的現金，扣除資本支出後，還能留下多少資金。對大規模建置AI資料中心的公司而言，即使營收與帳面獲利增加，只要購買設備、建置機房的支出更大，現金仍可能持續流出。
因此，甲骨文提出轉正時間表，重要之處不在於宣告「燒錢已經結束」，而是讓投資人有更明確的時間基準，檢驗這輪擴張能否開始產生現金回報。
需要注意的是，甲骨文會計年度於每年5月底結束，文中的2028、2029會計年度，不能直接等同曆年。

額外籌資上限200億美元，不代表整輪投資只需這筆錢
除了現金回收時程，甲骨文也表示，至2030會計年度的投資週期，額外向資本市場籌集的資金將以200億美元為限，目前預計股權與債務融資各約100億美元。
但這項上限不包含既有債務再融資，也不包含公司已在2027會計年度第一季完成的200億美元股票籌資。換句話說，不能把它解讀成整輪AI擴張只需要籌資200億美元。
對股東而言，後續應觀察實際增資與舉債是否符合規劃，以及取得的資金能否順利轉化為可使用的運算容量、客戶收入與現金流。

雲端基礎設施營收翻倍，成長已有實際數字支撐
甲骨文先前公布的2027會計年度第一季財報，已呈現AI基礎設施需求帶來的成長。
當季總營收約193億美元，年增30%；總雲端營收約116億美元，年增62%。其中，雲端基礎設施業務營收約74億美元，年增121%，明顯快於雲端應用業務的10%增幅。
這意味著，甲骨文的擴張並非只有遠期想像，運算與雲端基礎設施需求已反映在收入上。但營收成長只是第一步，新增資料中心能否有效利用、設備投入能否創造足夠報酬，才會決定最終能留下多少現金。

2030財年營收拚2,250億美元，仍是目標而非保證
甲骨文此次提出，2030會計年度營收目標至少2,250億美元，調整後營業利益率超過40%，調整後每股盈餘超過21美元；公司也重申2027會計年度營收至少900億美元、調整後EPS為8.10美元的展望。
不過，中長期財測仍建立在資料中心建置、客戶需求與成本控制等假設之上。若設備交付、產能使用或客戶專案進度不如預期，收入與現金回收時程也可能改變。
因此，不能只看2030年的營收目標，更要逐季追蹤營業現金流、資本支出與新增融資需求，確認公司是否朝規劃方向前進。

股價先反映期待，下一步看現金流兌現
甲骨文這次財測更新，讓AI擴張故事多了一個可驗證的焦點：投資高峰之後，公司能否減少對外部資金的依賴，開始靠自身營運支撐成長。
股價大漲11%，反映市場對這份路線圖的正面反應，但並不代表投資回收已經完成。接下來真正重要的，是資本支出能否按計畫度過高峰，以及自由現金流能否如期轉正。
對甲骨文而言，AI競賽的下一道考題，已不只是「能建多少資料中心」，而是這些投入最終能為股東留下多少現金。

paras_en: October 29, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – As AI data centers continue to expand, investors are no longer only interested in how many orders tech companies can secure, but when the invested capital can be recouped.

Oracle (ORCL-US) updated its mid‑to‑long‑term financial outlook on October 28 U.S. time, projecting that free cash flow will turn positive in the second half of fiscal 2028 and reach at least $30 billion in fiscal 2029, while setting an upper limit for additional fundraising. The news eased market concerns about AI investment funding needs and drove the stock up about 11% at the close that day.
(Image source: U‑Analysis industry database)

Capital spending peaks first, cash‑recovery targets follow. Oracle said fiscal 2027 and 2028 will be the peak years for capital expenditures, with spending expected to decline from fiscal 2029 onward. The company aims to achieve positive free cash flow in the second half of fiscal 2028 and to fund growth from its own cash starting fiscal 2029.

Free cash flow can be understood as the cash generated from operations after deducting capital expenditures. For companies building AI data centers at scale, even if revenue and accounting profit rise, cash can still flow out if equipment purchases and data‑center construction costs exceed those gains.

Therefore, Oracle’s announced turnaround timetable is important not because it declares “the money‑burning phase is over,” but because it gives investors a clearer time benchmark to assess whether this expansion round can start delivering cash returns.
It should be noted that Oracle’s fiscal year ends at the end of May each year, so the fiscal 2028 and 2029 mentioned in the article do not correspond directly to calendar years.

An additional fundraising cap of $20 billion does not mean the entire AI expansion requires only that amount. Oracle also said that for the investment cycle through fiscal 2030, the total amount it may raise from capital markets will be capped at $20 billion, with roughly $10 billion each planned from equity and debt financing.

However, this cap excludes refinancing of existing debt and does not include the $20 billion equity raise that the company completed in the first quarter of fiscal 2027. In other words, it should not be interpreted as the whole AI expansion needing only $20 billion of new capital.

Shareholders should watch whether actual equity issuances and debt borrowings stay within the plan, and whether the raised funds can be smoothly converted into usable compute capacity, customer revenue, and cash flow.
Cloud infrastructure revenue has doubled, with growth now backed by concrete numbers. Oracle’s previously released Q1 fiscal 2027 results already show growth driven by AI infrastructure demand.

For the quarter, total revenue was about $19.3 billion, up 30% year over year; total cloud revenue was about $11.6 billion, up 62% YoY. Cloud infrastructure revenue was roughly $7.4 billion, up 121% YoY, clearly outpacing the 10% growth in cloud applications.

This means Oracle’s expansion is not just a distant vision; compute and cloud infrastructure demand is already reflected in revenue. Yet revenue growth is only the first step—whether new data centers can be efficiently utilized and whether equipment investments generate sufficient returns will determine how much cash ultimately remains.

The company set a fiscal 2030 revenue target of at least $225 billion, adjusted operating margin above 40%, and adjusted EPS above $21. Oracle also reaffirmed its outlook for fiscal 2027 revenue of at least $90 billion and adjusted EPS of $8.10.

However, the mid‑to‑long‑term outlook still rests on assumptions about data‑center builds, customer demand, and cost control. If equipment deliveries, capacity utilization, or customer project timelines fall short, both revenue and cash‑recovery timing could change.
Thus, one should not focus solely on the 2030 revenue goal but also track quarterly operating cash flow, capital spending, and new financing needs to confirm the company is moving as planned.

Oracle’s latest outlook adds a verifiable focus to the AI expansion story: after the investment peak, can the company reduce reliance on external capital and start supporting growth with its own operations?

The 11% stock surge reflects the market’s positive reaction to this roadmap, but it does not mean the investment payback is complete. The real test ahead is whether capital spending can pass the peak as scheduled and whether free cash flow turns positive as expected.
For Oracle, the next challenge in the AI race is no longer just “how many data centers can be built,” but how much cash these investments ultimately leave for shareholders.

items.title: Google股價恐遭遇多年來最嚴重的下跌？營收、獲利雙雙不如預期  盤後暴跌9.4%
items.title_en: Is Google Stock Facing Its Worst Decline in Years? Revenue and Profit Both Miss Expectations, After-Hours Drop 9.4%
paras: Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 周三（28日）公布第三季財報，營收與每股盈餘雙雙低於市場預期，儘管Google Cloud營收年增逾一倍、表現亮眼，但搜尋與廣告業務未達市場期待，加上人工智慧（AI）基礎設施支出持續攀升，引發投資人對AI投資回報及核心搜尋業務成長動能的疑慮，Alphabet股價盤後重挫逾9%。
根據《MarketWatch》報導，財報顯示，Alphabet第三季營收年增25%至1,276億美元，低於分析師預期的1,280億美元；每股盈餘為2.12美元，也不及市場預估的3.02美元。
每股盈餘低於預期，主要受到一筆86億美元的股權投資帳面損失拖累，公司將這筆損失歸因於對SpaceX(SPCX-US) 的投資。
Alphabet股價周三盤後下跌9.4%。若跌勢延續至周四正常交易時段，將創下自2023年10月單日下跌9.5%以來最大跌幅。
Google Cloud成為本季財報亮點，營收年增103%至307.1億美元，大幅超越華爾街預期的288億美元。然而，搜尋與廣告等核心業務表現不如預期，未能抵銷其他業務的疲弱。
Bernstein分析師Mark Shmulik在周三發布的報告中指出，Alphabet本季財報初步呈現的負面因素遠多於正面消息。Google搜尋營收年增12%，低於第二季的17%，成長幅度明顯放緩。
值得注意的是，Google搜尋查詢量的成長幅度已達5年來最高水準，卻未能帶動搜尋營收同步加速。
Alphabet在財報電話會議中表示，本季搜尋營收受到匯率波動影響。此外，AI模式（AI Mode）的平均查詢長度約為傳統搜尋的3倍，但目前變現能力仍較低。
Google Cloud雖然大幅超越華爾街整體預期，Shmulik指出，機構投資人在財報公布前，原本期待該業務成長率超過115%，因此實際表現仍未完全滿足市場的高標準。
Alphabet持續投入大量資金建置AI基礎設施，第三季相關支出達514億美元。由於設備與資料中心投入的資金超過公司業務所創造的現金，Alphabet當季自由現金流轉為負91億美元。
Direxion產品與策略資深副總裁Ryan Lee在周三發布的報告中表示，這份財報顯示，Google仍面臨如何將AI投資轉化為營收的挑戰。
他形容目前的情況是「糟糕的組合」，並指出，若AI投資遲遲無法變現，或核心業務未能成長以彌補支出，持續燒錢將愈來愈難以合理化。
市場另一項隱憂，是AI競爭者可能逐步侵蝕Google的搜尋市場。
法國巴黎銀行（BNP Paribas）分析師Nick Jones在周三的報告中指出，Alphabet最新財報可能再次引發市場對OpenAI旗下ChatGPT及Meta(META-US) Muse代理工具搶占Google搜尋業務的擔憂。
投資人尤其關注AI代理購物服務的發展。如果消費者未來主要透過AI代理瀏覽網頁、尋找商品及完成購物，傳統搜尋引擎的使用方式可能改變，進而衝擊Google仰賴搜尋流量的廣告營收。
paras_en: Alphabet, Google’s parent company (GOOGL-US), released its third‑quarter earnings on Wednesday (the 28th). Both revenue and earnings per share fell short of market expectations. Although Google Cloud’s revenue more than doubled year‑over‑year and shone brightly, the search and advertising businesses missed the mark, and rising AI infrastructure spending has sparked investor worries about AI ROI and the growth momentum of core search, sending Alphabet’s stock down more than 9% in after‑hours trading.

According to MarketWatch, the report showed third‑quarter revenue rose 25% year‑over‑year to $127.6 billion, below analysts’ forecast of $128.0 billion; earnings per share came in at $2.12, also missing the consensus estimate of $3.02.
The EPS shortfall was largely due to an $8.6 billion equity‑investment write‑down, which the company attributed to its stake in SpaceX (SPCX‑US).
Alphabet’s shares fell 9.4% after hours on Wednesday. If the decline continues into Thursday’s regular session, it would be the steepest single‑day drop since the 9.5% slide on October 2023.

Google Cloud was the standout of the quarter, with revenue up 103% year‑over‑year to $30.71 billion, far exceeding Wall Street’s $28.8 billion expectation. However, core businesses such as search and advertising underperformed, failing to offset weakness elsewhere.

Bernstein analyst Mark Shmulik noted in a Wednesday report that the negative factors in Alphabet’s quarterly results far outweigh the positives. Google search revenue grew 12% year‑over‑year, down from a 17% rise in Q2, indicating a clear slowdown.
It is noteworthy that Google search query growth hit its highest rate in five years, yet this did not translate into faster search‑revenue growth.

During the earnings call, Alphabet said the quarter’s search revenue was hit by currency fluctuations. The average query length for AI Mode is about three times that of traditional search, but its monetization remains low.

Although Google Cloud far outperformed overall Wall Street expectations, Shmulik pointed out that institutional investors had been hoping for a growth rate above 115% before the results, so the actual performance still fell short of the lofty market bar.

Alphabet continues to pour massive capital into AI infrastructure, with related spending reaching $51.4 billion in the quarter. Because equipment and data‑center outlays exceeded cash generated by the business, free cash flow turned negative $9.1 billion for the period.
Direxion senior vice president of products and strategy Ryan Lee said in a Wednesday note that the results show Google still faces the challenge of turning AI investments into revenue.

He described the situation as a “bad combination,” warning that if AI spending remains un‑monetized or core businesses fail to grow enough to offset the outlay, the relentless cash burn will become increasingly hard to justify.
Another market concern is that AI rivals could gradually erode Google’s search market share.

BNP Paribas analyst Nick Jones wrote in a Wednesday report that Alphabet’s latest results may reignite worries that OpenAI’s ChatGPT and Meta’s (META-US) Muse agents could chip away at Google’s search business.

Investors are especially watching the development of AI‑driven shopping agents. If consumers increasingly browse the web, discover products and complete purchases through AI agents, the way traditional search engines are used could shift, threatening Google’s ad revenue that relies on search traffic.

items.title: 巴西總統大選敗選者「人間蒸發」24小時後 抵達美國佛州邁阿密
items.title_en: Brazilian Presidential Election Defeated Candidate Disappears, Reappears 24 Hours Later in Miami, Florida
paras: 在戲劇性「人間蒸發」24小時後，巴西總統選舉中落敗的自由黨候選人佛拉維歐．波索納洛及家人28日抵達美國佛羅里達州邁阿密。
據《紐約時報》報導，上午9點半左右，波索納洛身穿黑色防彈背心，一臉凝重地與家人從邁阿密郊外一座私人機場的飛機上走下。這群人走出機場後不久，便在黑色雨傘遮掩下被引上一輛SUV，隨後在警車護送下疾馳而去。
英國《衛報》稱，波索納洛登車前未對記者說一句話，現場氣氛低調，沒有任何支持者到場迎接，只有約24名記者，被兩名美國海關與邊境保護局（CBP）人員擋在遠處。
波索納洛抵美數小時後，於28日下午在社交媒體發出長文，最初自封為巴西「合法當選總統」，向巴西民眾和國際社會發表講話，隨後刪除聲明，改用「領導人」一詞重新發布。
波索納洛在聲明中說，他離開巴西是為了「成為我的人民所應得的領袖」，他會在美國繼續領導巴西反對派。
他否認逃離巴西，解釋離開是為了保護自己和家人，「我想澄清一點：我沒逃離巴西，我離開巴西，但我沒有拋棄巴西人民」。
儘管他所在的自由黨以及多個曾支持他的右翼、中右翼政黨均已承認現任總統盧拉勝選，波索納洛仍堅稱大選勝利被「竊取」，是被盧拉和最高法院通過「選舉政變」剝奪。
巴西三大主要報紙《聖保羅頁報》、《環球報》和《聖保羅州報》均將這份聲明稱為「煽動政變」。
波索納洛在信中特別感謝美國總統川普以及美國民眾，並感謝阿根廷總統米萊展現出的勇氣、正義感和法治精神。
川普於27日晚間證實，已批准波索納洛一家移居美國。早前美國國務院透露，將向波索納洛及其家人發放簽證，但沒有證實他們的行程。
不過，被問及這份長篇聲明時，川普稱他不會介入巴西大選後動盪局勢。他說，「嗯，我不會對此發表評論，但我知道我國給了他入境許可，所以我們拭目以待，但我不會介入。」
paras_en: In a dramatic "vanishing" 24 hours after his disappearance, the Liberal Party candidate who lost Brazil's presidential election, Flávio Bolsonaro, and his family arrived in Miami, Florida, on the 28th.

According to the New York Times, around 9:30 a.m. Bolsonaro, wearing a black bullet‑proof vest and looking solemn, stepped off a private‑airport plane with his family on the outskirts of Miami. Shortly after exiting the airport, they were ushered under a black umbrella to an SUV and then whisked away in a police escort.

The Guardian reported that Bolsonaro did not say a word to reporters before getting into the vehicle; the scene was low‑key, with no supporters present, only about 24 journalists kept at a distance by two U.S. Customs and Border Protection officers.

A few hours after arriving in the United States, Bolsonaro posted a lengthy message on social media on the afternoon of the 28th, initially proclaiming himself Brazil's "legitimate elected president" and addressing the Brazilian public and the international community, then later deleting that claim and reposting it using the term "leader" instead.
In the statement, Bolsonaro said he left Brazil to "be the leader my people deserve" and that he would continue to lead Brazil's opposition from the United States.

He denied that he was fleeing Brazil, explaining that his departure was to protect himself and his family, adding, "I want to make one thing clear: I did not flee Brazil, I left Brazil, but I did not abandon the Brazilian people."

Even though his Liberal Party and several right‑wing and centre‑right parties that had backed him have all acknowledged incumbent President Lula's victory, Bolsonaro continues to claim the election was "stolen" and that Lula and the Supreme Court orchestrated an "electoral coup" to strip him of power.
Brazil's three major newspapers—the São Paulo Gazette, O Globo, and the São Paulo State Journal—have all described his statement as "incitement to a coup."

In his letter, Bolsonaro specifically thanked U.S. President Donald Trump and the American people, and also expressed gratitude to Argentine President Javier Milei for his courage, sense of justice, and commitment to the rule of law.

Trump confirmed on the evening of the 27th that he had approved Bolsonaro and his family's relocation to the United States. Earlier, the State Department had disclosed that visas would be issued to Bolsonaro and his family, though it had not confirmed their travel plans.

When asked about the lengthy statement, Trump said he would not intervene in Brazil's post‑election turmoil, stating, "Well, I won't comment on that, but I know our country gave him entry permission, so we'll see what happens, but I won't get involved."

隨著也門戰事持續，外界擔憂中東能源進一步受擾提升油價，美元仍保持避險貨幣地位，而且儘管日本政府一再否認，但其整體立場偏向再通貨膨脹，可能設法推遲BOJ升息，令日圓承壓，美元兌日圓升至158.34高點。隨後美國公布9月商品貿易逆差意外擴大至1,349億美元，並據FED以10票贊成、理事庫克和克利夫蘭聯邦儲備銀行總裁哈馬克主張加息25個基點，如預期維持聯邦基金利率區間在3.75%-4.00%，而且FED主席沃什在新聞會表示，經濟成長強勁的和通貨膨脹高企，未來仍可能再收緊貨幣政策，芝加哥商品交易所（CME）的FedWatch工具則顯示FED在12月加息的機率85%，但本次會議結果已在廣泛預期中，引發美元兌日圓回落。預估今日美元兌日圓支撐於157.50-70，阻力於158.30-50。
◆EUR/USD

昨日澳洲公布第三季消費者物價指數(CPI)較前季升1.3%及較上年同期漲3.9%，澳洲央行(RBA)總裁布洛克則警告物價壓力仍居高不下，政策制定者將於下周討論今年四次升息是否足以實現通貨膨脹目標，提升RBA下週二加息25個基點的機率至88%，但紐西蘭央行(RBNZ)意外維持利率不變，儘管稱未來或仍需收緊政策，引發紐元暴跌，並據德國報告稱，受中國需求轉弱拖累出口，今年德國對亞太地區二十九個經濟體的出口料下降3.2%至1,853億歐元，對亞太貿易逆差料創紀錄高位，推低歐元兌美元至1.1131低點。

paras: 加拿大央行周三(28日)宣布升息1碼(25個基點)，將基準隔夜利率提高至2.5%，為2023年7月以來首次升息，符合市場預期。央行警告，中東戰事推升能源價格，可能進一步擴散至其他商品與服務，未來仍可能需要升息，但考量經濟與地緣政治的不確定性，將謹慎行事。

防堵能源成本擴散 通膨回歸目標延至2028年

加拿大央行總裁馬克林(Tiff Macklem)表示，通膨展望明顯升高，加上經濟展現韌性，有必要調高利率，降低能源價格上漲演變為全面性通膨的風險。決策委員會認為，通膨風險增加，貨幣政策維持寬鬆的空間已縮小。
加拿大9月通膨率升至3.2%，超出央行1%至3%的目標區間，主要來自能源與相關運輸成本。央行預估，通膨年底將達3.5%，明年多數時間維持約3%，直到2028年中才回到接近2%的目標。
央行同步將2027年平均通膨預測，由7月估計的2%大幅上修至3.1%。馬克林指出，過往經驗與企業調查顯示，未來一年成本轉嫁程度將提高，使能源漲價對通膨的影響更持久。
不過，決策委員會也討論過維持利率不變，理由包括物價壓力仍集中於能源、經濟尚有閒置產能，以及美加關稅爭端可能拖累成長。馬克林強調，未來將逐次會議評估政策，未承諾連續升息。

經濟展望上修 關稅與就業疲弱仍構成風險

加拿大央行將今年經濟成長預測由0.7%上修至1%，並將2027年及2028年預測，由各1.8%提高至2%。聯邦政府推動的生產力投資抵減措施與重大建設，是支撐成長的部分原因。
短期動能仍可能放緩。央行預估，經濟成長年率將從第二季的3.3%，降至第三季的2%，第四季再降至0.8%，反映美國新增關稅的衝擊。馬克林預期，2027年可望隨消費支出延續、出口回升及企業投資增強而恢復動能，逐步吸收閒置產能。
然而，加拿大就業人數已連續兩個月下滑，房市疲弱，移民減少也對部分產業形成壓力。反對升息的經濟學家認為，排除波動項目的核心通膨仍約2%，此時緊縮可能妨礙溫和復甦。
加拿大帝國商業銀行資本市場經濟學家Andrew Grantham預期，核心通膨不會如央行擔憂般加速，政策利率應無須升破2.75%。Servus Credit Union首席經濟學家Charles St-Arnaud則認為，除非經濟轉弱或通膨低於預期，否則12月仍可能再升息。
決策公布後，加幣變動不大，約報1美元兌1.405加幣。加拿大央行下次利率決策訂於12月9日。
paras_en: The Bank of Canada announced on Wednesday (the 28th) that it is raising its policy overnight rate by one quarter point (25 basis points) to 2.5%, its first hike since July 2023 and in line with market expectations. The bank warned that the Middle‑East conflict is pushing up energy prices, which could spill over into other goods and services, and that further rate hikes may be needed, but it will act cautiously given economic and geopolitical uncertainties.

To curb the spread of higher energy costs and bring inflation back to target by 2028, Governor Tiff Macklem said that the inflation outlook has risen sharply and, combined with a resilient economy, makes a rate increase necessary to reduce the risk that rising energy prices turn into broad‑based inflation. The policy committee sees rising inflation risks and a shrinking scope for accommodative policy.

Canada’s September inflation rate rose to 3.2%, above the bank’s 1‑3% target range, driven mainly by energy and related transport costs. The bank projects inflation will reach 3.5% by year‑end and stay around 3% for most of next year, only returning to near‑2% by mid‑2028.

At the same time, the bank lifted its 2027 average inflation forecast from the July estimate of 2% to 3.1%. Macklem noted that past experience and business surveys suggest cost‑pass‑through will increase over the next year, making the impact of energy price hikes on inflation more persistent.

However, the committee also discussed keeping rates unchanged, citing that price pressures remain concentrated in energy, there is still idle capacity in the economy, and the US‑Canada tariff dispute could weigh on growth. Macklem stressed that policy will be assessed at each meeting and no commitment to consecutive hikes has been made.

The bank upgraded its economic outlook, raising this year’s growth forecast from 0.7% to 1% and lifting the 2027 and 2028 forecasts from 1.8% to 2%. Federal productivity‑investment tax credits and major infrastructure projects are cited as part of the growth support.

Short‑term momentum may still slow. The bank expects annualised growth to fall from 3.3% in Q2 to 2% in Q3 and to 0.8% in Q4, reflecting the impact of new US tariffs. Macklem expects momentum to recover in 2027 as consumer spending continues, exports rebound and business investment picks up, gradually absorbing idle capacity.

Nevertheless, Canadian employment has declined for two consecutive months, the housing market is weak, and reduced immigration is pressuring some sectors. Economists opposed to rate hikes argue that core inflation, stripped of volatile items, remains around 2%, and tightening now could hinder a modest recovery.

CIBC capital‑markets economist Andrew Grantham expects core inflation will not accelerate as the bank fears and that the policy rate need not rise above 2.75%. Servus Credit Union chief economist Charles St‑Arnaud believes another hike is still possible in December unless the economy weakens or inflation falls short of expectations.
After the decision, the Canadian dollar moved little, quoted at roughly 1 USD = 1.405 CAD. The Bank of Canada’s next rate decision is scheduled for December 9.

items.title: 紐西蘭央行意外按兵不動 維持利率於2.75% 委員會意見分歧
items.title_en: New Zealand Central Bank Unexpectedly Holds Rate at 2.75% Amid Committee Split
paras: 紐西蘭央行(RBNZ)周三(28日)出乎市場意料，決定將官方現金利率(OCR)維持在 2.75% 不變。在媒體調查的 25 位經濟學家當中，僅有 2 位預期利率將維持不動，其餘多數專家均預估央行會升息 1 碼(25 個基點)。
決策公布後，紐元兌美元一度重挫 1.7%(跌至 55.86 美分)，紐西蘭基準股指 NZX 50 下跌 0.5%，對政策敏感的 2 年期政府公債殖利率則下滑 12 個基點至 3.82%。
根據央行公布的會議紀錄，貨幣政策委員會(MPC)最終以 4 比 3 的微幅差距通過按兵不動的決議。委員Paul Conway、Hayley Gourley與Karen Silk投票支持升息 1 碼至 3.00%；然而包含總裁Anna Breman與Prasanna Gai在內的 4 位委員則選擇維持利率不變。
主張暫緩升息者指出，當前經濟復甦步調脆弱，特別是家庭消費與投資意願低迷，且全球地緣政治與經濟環境突變的風險升高，因此宜採取觀望態度。
紐西蘭央行總裁 Breman表示：「在本次會議中，我們認為符合先前溝通方針是適當的，即維持基準利率不變，並持續釋出未來幾次會議極可能進一步升息的訊號。」
針對紐元下挫對通膨的影響，Breman補充說明：「當面對通膨壓力時，我們當然樂見紐元走強，但我們必須將其與影響中長期通膨的所有其他因素綜合權衡。因此我們正在密切觀察並謹慎評估其對未來通膨的影響。」
然而，這項決策遭到市場經濟學家的強烈質疑。Bank of New Zealand研究主管Stephen Toplis表示：「坦白說，我們對紐西蘭央行維持利率不變的決定感到大吃一驚。雖然央行並無義務跟隨市場定價或共識，但如此背道而馳極為罕見。央行此舉推動本已疲軟的紐元進一步下跌，瞬間加劇了通膨壓力。」
儘管紐西蘭 9 月季度消費者物價年增率已自前季的 4.1% 放緩至 3.7%，但仍高於央行設定的 1% 至 3% 目標區間。紐西蘭央行強調，若國內物價壓力未能有效緩解，後續會議仍不排除重新採取緊縮政策。
paras_en: The Reserve Bank of New Zealand (RBNZ) on Wednesday (the 28th) surprised markets by deciding to keep the official cash rate (OCR) unchanged at 2.75%. Of the 25 economists surveyed by the media, only two expected the rate to stay steady, while the majority forecast a one‑point (25‑basis‑point) hike.

After the decision was announced, the New Zealand dollar fell as much as 1.7% against the U.S. dollar, sliding to US$0.5586, the NZX 50 index dropped 0.5%, and the policy‑sensitive two‑year government bond yield slipped 12 basis points to 3.82%.

According to the minutes released by the bank, the Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) approved the hold by a narrow 4‑to‑3 vote. Committee members Paul Conway, Hayley Gourley and Karen Silk voted for a one‑point increase to 3.00%, while four members, including Governor Anna Breman and Prasanna Gai, voted to keep the rate unchanged.

Those advocating a pause argued that the current economic recovery is fragile, especially with weak household consumption and investment appetite, and that the risk of sudden shifts in the global geopolitical and economic environment has risen, warranting a wait‑and‑see approach.

RBNZ Governor Breman said, "In this meeting we felt it was appropriate to follow our prior communication stance, namely to keep the policy rate unchanged while continuing to signal that future meetings are very likely to see further hikes."

Addressing the impact of the dollar’s decline on inflation, Breman added, "When faced with inflationary pressure we would of course welcome a stronger NZD, but we have to weigh that against all other factors affecting medium‑ to long‑term inflation. We are therefore monitoring closely and carefully assessing its effect on future inflation."

However, the decision was met with strong criticism from market economists. Stephen Toplis, research head at Bank of New Zealand, said, "Frankly, we were shocked by the RBNZ’s decision to hold rates. While the bank is not obliged to follow market pricing or consensus, such a divergence is extremely rare. The move pushes an already weak NZD even lower, instantly amplifying inflation pressures."

Even though New Zealand’s September quarterly CPI annual growth slowed from 4.1% in the prior quarter to 3.7%, it remains above the bank’s 1%‑3% target range. The RBNZ stressed that if domestic price pressures do not ease effectively, future meetings could still see a return to tightening.

items.title: 最穩貨幣變「科技籌碼」？AI正改變美元避險邏輯　專家：一旦交易逆轉  外資撤離恐成新風險
items.title_en: Is the Safest Currency Turning into a "Tech Bet"? AI Is Changing the Dollar's Hedge Logic – Expert Warns That a Trade Reversal Could Trigger Capital Outflows as a New Risk
paras: 美元長期被視為全球動盪時的首選避風港，但隨著海外資金大舉湧入美國AI概念股、公司債與電力基礎設施，這項「避險屬性」正被重新定價，美元也越來越像一檔綁定科技敘事的「高貝他資產」。對此專家最新指出，一旦AI交易邏輯動搖，美元未必再從恐慌中受惠，反而可能面臨資金撤離的雙重打擊。
野村證券G10外匯策略主管Dominic Bunning直言，若AI交易出現逆轉，「美元能否像過去那樣受益，已沒那麼確定」。上周市場已見初步痕跡，AI資產估值承壓時，避險資金轉向日元與瑞郎，而非美元，美元兌歐元小幅升值，主要反映法國社會動盪拖累歐元，而非避險買盤進場。
Convera首席外匯與宏觀策略師Kevin Ford指出，當AI交易被放在放大鏡下檢視，其與美元走勢的連動反而更清晰。外資流入美股規模已創下歷史紀錄，但外國直接投資(FDI)成長落後，意味著增量資金多來自法人機構的可移動倉位，本質上接近新興市場常見的「熱錢」。
富國銀行Erik Nelson將其比作新興市場資本流動，並稱AI熱潮強化了「美國成長更快、通膨更黏、利率更高」的預期，推升美元與美債殖利率同步走強。
此外，支撐邏輯也是風險源頭。若AI投報率不及預期，拋售可能同時蔓延至股票、投資級信貸與利率市場，成長放緩迫使Fed降息、削弱收益優勢，資本開支減速動搖「美國例外論」，機構降低美股與企業債配置，則直接抽走美元流入底座。
相較於2000年網路泡沫時期，當前脆弱性更集中。目前，外資更集中押注美股與公司債，直接投資偏弱。按貿易加權實質匯率，美元已經連12年高於長期均值，創1973年來最長紀錄。
加拿大帝國商業銀行資本市場(CIBC)FICC策略總監Noah Buffam說，AI交易推動利率預期重定價，是這波美元漲勢的核心驅動。
高負債雲端運算商CoreWeave等企業的信用違約交換(CDS)利差近周大幅擴張，加拿大豐業銀行(Scotiabank)首席外匯策略師Shaun Osborne表示，信貸市場正釋出風險由表層滲出的訊號。若基設報酬落空，信用利差走闊、削減資本開支，衝擊將外溢至硬體、工業設備與能源需求。
此外，美國政府財政空間也比2000年更窄。當年接近預算盈餘，現在則是巨額赤字，逆周期刺激餘地有限。判斷美元是否轉弱，關鍵不在科技股單日大跌，而在信貸與增長壓力是否改變Fed路徑，但若是成真，日元將率先受惠。
不過美元崩跌並非必然。若拋售嚴重到引發全球美元融資搶籌，2008與2020年式的「流動性逼升」仍可能短線推高美元，只是難以持續。
Nelson也提醒，全球投資人對美元重定價的敏感度極高，展望2027年，這道被AI綁住的避險裂縫，值得持續盯防。
paras_en: The dollar has long been seen as the go‑to safe haven during global turmoil, but as overseas capital pours into U.S. AI‑related stocks, corporate bonds and power infrastructure, this "hedge attribute" is being re‑priced, making the dollar increasingly resemble a high‑beta asset tied to a tech narrative. Experts now warn that if AI‑driven trading logic wavers, the dollar may no longer benefit from panic and could instead face a double hit from capital withdrawals.

Nomura’s G10 FX strategy head Dominic Bunning bluntly said that if AI‑driven trading reverses, “it’s no longer certain the dollar will benefit as it has in the past.” Last week the market showed early signs: as AI asset valuations came under pressure, safe‑haven flows shifted to the yen and the franc rather than the dollar, while the dollar‑euro pair edged higher mainly because French social unrest weighed on the euro, not because of hedge buying.

Convera’s chief FX and macro strategist Kevin Ford noted that when AI trading is examined under a microscope, its correlation with the dollar becomes even clearer. Foreign inflows into U.S. equities have hit historic highs, but foreign direct investment (FDI) growth lags, meaning the incremental money largely comes from institutional “portable” positions – essentially the same hot‑money flows typical of emerging markets.

Wells Fargo’s Erik Nelson likened the situation to emerging‑market capital flows, saying the AI boom reinforces expectations of “faster U.S. growth, stickier inflation and higher rates,” which pushes the dollar and U.S. Treasury yields higher together.

Moreover, the supporting logic is itself a source of risk. If AI returns fall short of expectations, sell‑offs could spill over to equities, investment‑grade credit and the rate markets; slower growth would force the Fed to cut rates, eroding the yield advantage, while a slowdown in capex would undermine the “U.S. exception” thesis, prompting institutions to trim U.S. equity and corporate‑bond allocations and directly pull the dollar’s inflow base.

Compared with the 2000‑dot‑com bubble, today’s vulnerabilities are more concentrated. Foreign capital is now more focused on U.S. equities and corporate bonds, with direct investment weaker. On a trade‑weighted real exchange‑rate basis, the dollar has been above its long‑term average for 12 consecutive years, the longest stretch since 1973.
CIBC’s FICC strategy head Noah Buffam said AI‑driven trading is reshaping rate expectations, which is the core driver of the current dollar rally.

Credit‑default‑swap spreads on highly leveraged cloud‑computing firms such as CoreWeave have widened sharply in recent weeks. Scotiabank’s chief FX strategist Shaun Osborne warned that the credit market is sending early warning signals from the surface. If underlying AI returns disappoint, widening credit spreads and reduced capex will spill over to hardware, industrial equipment and energy demand.

In addition, the U.S. fiscal space is tighter than in 2000. Back then the budget was near surplus; today it runs a massive deficit, leaving little room for counter‑cyclical stimulus. Whether the dollar weakens hinges less on a single day’s tech‑stock plunge and more on whether credit and growth pressures alter the Fed’s policy path – and if that happens, the yen would be the first beneficiary.

Nevertheless, a dollar collapse is not inevitable. If sell‑offs become severe enough to trigger a global scramble for dollar funding, a liquidity‑driven surge akin to 2008 or 2020 could temporarily push the dollar higher, though such a rally would be hard to sustain.

Nelson also cautioned that global investors are extremely sensitive to any re‑pricing of the dollar. Looking ahead to 2027, the AI‑tied hedge crack in the dollar’s safe‑haven status deserves close monitoring.

items.title: 〈楊金龍立院備詢〉重申匯市依循「柳樹理論」可防範波動過大
items.title_en: Yang Jinlong Reiterates That Following the “Willow Tree Theory” in the FX Market Can Prevent Excessive Volatility
paras: 中央銀行總裁楊金龍今(28)日赴立院財委會備詢，立委提及台股交投集中於特定產業，外資調節高科技股的水位就會造成新台幣的貶值壓力。對此，楊金龍回應，央行依循「柳樹理論」讓匯率適度擺動，不會睡不安穩，並再次強調沒有楊金龍防線。
楊金龍說，儘管近期因外資大幅匯出有使新台幣大幅波動，但仍睡得很安穩，畢竟匯率主要還是由供需決定，而外資在股市賺錢自然會獲利了結並匯出。
楊金龍強調，央行面對匯市一向採「柳樹理論」，讓匯率適度擺動，出現異常波動或失序時，在基於維持金融穩定立場下才會調節，以防波動過大。
楊金龍也指出，高科技業是台灣更具比較利益的產業，也是我們台灣最值得去發展的方向。
此外，楊金龍再度表示，市場資金需求相當旺盛，而我國擁有龐大的超額儲蓄，資金池充裕。
paras_en: On October 28, Central Bank Governor Yang Jinlong appeared before the Legislative Yuan’s Finance Committee. Legislators noted that trading in Taiwan’s stock market is concentrated in certain sectors, and that foreign investors adjusting the level of high‑tech stocks could create depreciation pressure on the New Taiwan dollar. In response, Yang said the central bank follows the “Willow Tree Theory” to allow the exchange rate to move moderately, ensuring stability, and he again emphasized that there is no “Yang Jinlong defense line.”

Yang explained that although recent large outflows by foreign investors have caused the New Taiwan dollar to swing sharply, the currency remains stable because exchange rates are fundamentally driven by supply and demand, and foreign investors naturally realize profits in the stock market and repatriate the proceeds.

Yang stressed that the central bank has always applied the “Willow Tree Theory” to the foreign‑exchange market, permitting moderate fluctuations. Only when abnormal or disorderly swings occur, and in order to maintain financial stability, will the bank intervene to curb excessive volatility.
Yang also pointed out that the high‑tech sector is Taiwan’s comparative advantage and the most worthwhile direction for the country’s development.
Furthermore, Yang reiterated that market demand for capital is very strong, and Taiwan enjoys a large surplus of savings, providing a plentiful pool of funds.
